ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
Our vision is to make communication and creation with technology seamless. We started by building with the first human-like voice model. Now we’ve expanded well beyond voice.

ElevenLabs Affiliate Partner Guide
Welcome partner,
We're excited to have you on board and we can't wait to see what you'll create as an ElevenLabs Affiliate. To make your setup seamless, we've divided this guide into two parts: a step-by-step guide to get you started and earning and an overview of ElevenLabs technology.
Getting Started with ParterStack
After signing up on our ElevenLabs Affiliates landing page, you’ll be prompted to enter your email address. If you already have an ElevenLabs account, we recommend using the same email; otherwise, feel free to use any active email address.
You’ll be directed to our web platform to sign up for PartnerStack, our third-party affiliate management platform.
Once you’ve completed the onboarding with PartnerStack, you’ll be taken directly to your personal dashboard’s Home page. On this page, you’ll find an overview of the programs you’re partnered with, a summary of your performance, and recent referral activity.
Click into your ElevenLabs program to track your referral link metrics, view your commission earnings, and explore our ElevenLabs resources.
Here, you’ll also be able to access your unique partner link and create custom links tailored to your name, social media handle, business, or product.
To withdraw your commissions, you’ll need to set up your bank account. Simply click Commissions on the top navigation bar, then select Setup Withdrawals. PartnerStack’s payment period runs from the 1st to the 15th of each month.
All things payment
For every new paid subscriber plan, you’ll earn 22% on all payments from our Starter, Creator, Pro and Scale Payments for the first 12 months. You’ll also earn 11% on all payments from our Business Tier.
Once your referral has made their first payment, your commission fee is valid 90 days after. This is due to the dispute deadline of customers’ credit cards. For example, if someone you refer purchases a paid license on Feb 10th, that referral becomes 'active' on May 10th and you will be paid on the next payment period (in June).
The accumulated active commission fees are paid out once per month via PartnerStack. If there are payment issues, please reach out to them directly.
Tagging
To ensure we can see and share your creations, we encourage you to tag us in your social content.
We love seeing what you create, and if we love them, we’ll reshare!
You can find us on:
Twitter
@elevenlabsio
Instagram
@elevenlabsio
LinkedIn
@elevenlabsio
Facebook
@elevenlabsio
Discord
If you're on Discord, be sure to join our ElevenLabs Discord channel -
https://discord.com/invite/elevenlabs.
We post updates on all our latest features so you’ll be ready to upload content as soon as they launch—helping you drive more views and engagement.
We also have a dedicated Partner channel for affiliates, where you can ask questions, receive updates, and access opportunities for free credits with new feature launches - link to follow.
ElevenLabs Overview
ElevenLabs is a voice AI research & deployment company with a mission to make content universally accessible in any language and voice. Our voice generator can deliver high-quality, versatile, human-like and contextually-aware AI voices, which has built the foundations of our frontier AI audio platform.
Our Products
Text to Speech
The ElevenLabs voice generator can deliver high-quality, human-like speech in 32 languages. Perfect for audiobooks, videos, voice overs, commercials, vlogs and any social platform.
Speech to Speech
Say it how you want it and hear it delivered in another voice with full control over the delivery. Full control of the delivery for games, films and any character you can imagine.
Text to SFX
Create any sound effect, instrumental tracks or background noise you can imagine, with just a text prompt. Perfect for games, films, clips, movies and soundscapes.
Voice Isolator
Our vocal remover strips background noise for film, podcast, and interview post production, or any audio that needs a little focus.
Voice Cloning
Clone your own voice so you can automate video voice overs, ad reads, podcasts, and more.
Voice Designer
If we don’t have the voice your looking for, you can now create any with just a prompt. Your new go-to voiceover tool for creating social media content, commercials, podcasts, games and more.
Projects
Structure, edit, and generate long-form audio with precision, with our comprehensive workflow for turning books into audiobooks and scripts into podcasts, in one easy-to-use platform.
Dubbing Studio
Localize content across 29 languages with AI dubbing, translate audio and video while preserving the emotion, timing, tone and unique characteristics of each speaker. Localize your videos, clips, demo videos, customer help videos to expand your reach.
Voiceover Studio
Your new go-to voiceover tool for creating social media content, commercials, podcasts, and more
Voice Library
Discover the AI audio community where you can innovate, collaborate, and earn. From audiobook narrators to unique characters and everything in between, Voice Library has the best voices for your: brand voice, audio books, articles, commercials and more.
ElevenReader
Bring any book, article, PDF, newsletter, or text to life with ultra realistic AI narration in one app.
Contact
If you have any questions, don’t hesitate to reach out directly via Partnerstack, you can also reach us in your Dashboard if you have any ElevenLabs questions.
Thank you for your interest in our affiliate program - we can’t wait to see what you create.
FAQ'S
How do I withdraw my commissions?
Available payment options include Stripe, PayPal, and Direct Deposit, depending on your country. You can find more details on withdrawal options in PartnerStack.
What do my PartnerStack Dashboard statistics mean?
Clicks: The total number of clicks on your referral links.
Signups: The total number of individuals (both paid and unpaid) who signed up on a program’s website within 90 days of clicking your link.
Revenue: The total revenue generated from your referred customers.
Pending Commissions: The total earned commissions with statuses such as scheduled, pending approval, or approved and awaiting payment over the next 12 months.
Paid Commissions: The total commission you’ve earned that has been approved and paid by your partner programs.
How do I add a custom link?
In your Dashboard, go to Links, then select Custom Links. For more detailed instructions, check our help guide: https://support.partnerstack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360009476833-Creating-custom-referral-links
I received an elevenlabs.io affiliate link but can’t see it on my dashboard. Will this still work?
If you generated an instant signup elevenlabs.io link on our webpage, it is automatically connected to your PartnerStack account via the email address you provided. You can find this link on your ElevenLabs Dashboard under the Affiliates section, not in your PartnerStack Dashboard. While your elevenlabs.io commissions are linked to PartnerStack, please note that certain metrics (such as the number of clicks) will not be visible, as it functions as an instant link without tracking metrics.
I have both an elevenlabs.io affiliate link and a PartnerStack try.elevenlabs.io link. Will they both work?
Yes, your referral links are connected through the email address you provide. As long as you use the same email address, both links will connect seamlessly and contribute commissions to your PartnerStack Dashboard.
Did you remove the ability to generate an instant signup link on your webpage?
Yes, we have removed direct link generation on our webpage for new customers to streamline metrics. This change only affects new affiliates, who will use the PartnerStack links moving forward.
If I have multiple links, will they all work?
Yes, you can set up to 100 custom links for different products, personal brand names, social media handles, or webpage links. Each link will have its own metrics and will contribute to your overall commissions.
Can I start using my referral link straight away?
Yes, you can start using your referral link immediately; it will be active right away.
Can I run Google Ads with this affiliate link?
No, we don’t allow partners to use affiliate links in Google Ads. Violation of this policy will result in removal from the partner program.
Are there any help articles for ParterStack?
Yes, there are many, check out this intro to PartnerStack guide, you’ll also find many others.
https://support.partnerstack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360009183474-Intro-to-PartnerStack

For example, if someone you refer purchases a paid license on Feb 10th, that referral becomes 'active' on May 10th and you will be paid on the next payment period (in June). Our payment period happens between the 1st - 15th of each month.
What is the minimum payout threshold for the Creator Affiliate program?
The minimum payout threshold is $5.
How can I track my sales and commissions?
You can create, track, and promote your affiliate link by signing in to PartnerStack using the email sent to you when you generated your referral link.
Do I need to have a blog or website to join?
While having a blog or website can be beneficial, you can also promote ElevenLabs through social media, email, or any other platforms you prefer. As long as you follow the guidelines dictated in our terms of service
Can I refer other affiliates and earn from their sales?
Our primary focus is on product sales. Currently, we do not have a multi-tiered system where you earn from other affiliates' sales. But stay tuned for any updates on this!
What happens if a customer I referred requests a refund?
As an affiliate, you'll earn regular commission from a user as long as their paid subscription remains active during the first 12 months of sign-up. However, if a user cancels their plan, your monthly commission from their subscription will stop. Additionally, if a user requests a refund, your commission related to that purchase will not be paid or will be deducted from your following commission.
Who can I contact if I have more questions or need support?
We're here to help! You can reach out to our dedicated affiliate support team at
affiliates@elevenlabs.io
or through the contact form on our affiliate portal.
Can I earn commissions on my own purchases through my referral link?
No, affiliates are not eligible to earn commissions on their own purchases.
What is the cookie duration for my referral link?
The cookie duration is 90 days. This means if someone clicks on your referral link and makes a purchase within 90 days, you'll earn a commission for that sale.
Can I promote ElevenLabs internationally?
ElevenLabs is a global brand, and you can promote our products to audiences all over the world. However, we are only allowed to compensate commissions on sales where commissions are allowed.
How do I know if my promotional efforts are successful?
Your affiliate dashboard provides comprehensive analytics, including click-through rates, conversion rates, and total sales. Monitoring these metrics will give you insights into your promotional efforts' effectiveness.
What methods of promotion are not allowed in the affiliate program?
We do not allow spamming, misleading advertising, or any promotional methods that violate our Terms and Conditions. Any activity that could harm the reputation of ElevenLabs is strictly prohibited.
In addition, bidding on ElevenLabs’ branded keywords or variations (including misspellings) on any search engine is not allowed. Affiliates found participating in branded paid search auctions will forfeit all payouts accrued during that period and will be immediately removed from the program.
Can I create a website or social media profile that impersonates ElevenLabs for promotion?
No, creating a website or social media profile that may confuse visitors into thinking it's the official ElevenLabs site or profile is strictly prohibited.
Are there any types of content or platforms where I can't promote ElevenLabs?
Affiliates must not promote ElevenLabs on platforms or within content that is offensive, misleading, or in violation of any laws or community standards. This includes, but is not limited to, content that promotes hate, discrimination, or illegal activity.
Additionally, promotion through branded paid search (bidding on ElevenLabs’ name or related brand terms including misspellings) on any search engine is prohibited. This ensures fair competition and protects the integrity of ElevenLabs’ marketing efforts. Affiliates found participating in branded paid search auctions will forfeit all payouts accrued during that period and will be immediately removed from the program.
If I violate the promotional guidelines, what are the consequences?
Violating the promotional guidelines may result in the suspension or termination of your affiliate account and forfeiture of any earned commissions.
What is Partnerstack and how does it relate to the ElevenLabs Creator Affiliate Program?
Partnerstack is a platform dedicated to supporting partnership programs, enabling businesses to engage with affiliates, influencers, and resellers. As a member of the ElevenLabs Creator Affiliate Program, you'll use Partnerstack to monitor your earnings and analyze your performance metrics. Joining Partnerstack is a requisite for getting paid in this program. The platform offers an array of tools for tracking, management, and optimization of partnership-driven growth. It ensures smooth integration for affiliates and hassle-free commission disbursements. Numerous companies rely on Partnerstack to nurture and expand their partner ecosystems.
How do I promote ElevenLabs effectively?
You can promote ElevenLabs through a variety of channels, including your blog, social media platforms, YouTube channel, or even word of mouth. We provide promotional materials to help you here. Tailoring your message to your audience and sharing genuine experiences often yields the best results.
How should I go about tagging ElevenLabs on social media?
Thanks for the love! Here is a list of all our handles, including,
X
,
Instagram
,
Youtube
,
LinkedIn
, and
Discord
.
Are there any promotional materials provided?
Yes, we provide a range of marketing materials such as banners, product images, and sample posts to make your promotion easier and more effective. You are able to view these resources on your PartnerStack dashboard. You can also access logos of ElevenLabs
here
.
What are some guiding principles for promotion?
Here are three principles to remember as you consider ways to promote your affiliate link for ElevenLabs:
Maintain Authenticity: We've chosen you for this initiative because we recognize the synergy between you, your audience, and the ethos of ElevenLabs. Upholding authenticity in your promotions will resonate with your audience and bolster the image of ElevenLabs.
Tailor to Your Audience: You have the best understanding of your audience's preferences. Harness this knowledge! If your followers consist largely of tech enthusiasts, demonstrate the cutting-edge features of ElevenLabs. If they're audiophiles or professionals in the sound industry, showcase how ElevenLabs can revolutionize their audio experience. Ensure you're providing them with valuable insights tailored to their interests.
Maximize Exposure: Success in this endeavor hinges on extensive reach. Disseminate your link across as many platforms as possible. Whether it's websites, social media, or video channels, diversifying your promotion avenues will help capture a wider audience spectrum.

Frequently asked questions
What are AI agent templates?
AI agent templates are pre-built, configurable frameworks that allow you to deploy functional AI agents instantly without starting from scratch. They generally support voice and/or chat channels such as telephony, sms, whatsapp and more.
How are these AI agents being built?
These agents are built using ElevenAgents, a visual tool for building AI Agents. You can provide your SOPs and connect your company's systems quickly to create a customized agent for your use case in minutes not days.
Can I customize the agent logic?
Yes. Once you clone the template we will guide you through setting it up with all the right configurations and you will be able to modify logic blocks, prompts, or integrations to fit your business needs.
Are AI agent templates free?
Yes. ElevenAgents offers free AI agent templates across all categories, customer support, sales, coaching, HR, education, and more. You can deploy and customize any template at no cost on the free plan, with optional upgrades for higher usage limits and premium features. There's no credit card required to get started, and free-tier agents are fully functional, not limited demos.
How long does it take to deploy an AI agent from a template?
If you have all the right information and integrations for your business ready you can deploy an AI Agent from a template in under 10 minutes. Select a template, customize the persona and knowledge base to match your business, and click publish. Your agent immediately gets a shareable link, an embeddable chat widget you can drop onto any website, and full API access for custom integrations. No infrastructure setup, no DevOps, no waiting for deployments.
What AI models power the templates?
ElevenAgents supports most publicly available AI Models and you can even bring your own self hosted models. For a
full list of supported models refer to our docs
Can I embed the agent on my website?
Yes. Every published agent comes with a lightweight embed widget you can use to add it to your website. The widget renders as a floating bubble that opens into a full conversation interface. It's fully responsive, works on mobile, and loads asynchronously so it won't slow down your page.

What is a virtual call center agent?

Yes. Inbound use cases include support and FAQ handling, while outbound use cases range from follow-ups to collections and renewals. AI agents can scale across both functions in a single platform.
How quickly can a virtual call center agent be deployed?
Most businesses can launch in days. With prebuilt integrations, workflow design tools, and SDKs, it’s easy to stand up an AI-powered contact center without lengthy IT projects.
What results can I expect from AI-powered contact center agents?

Frequently asked questions
How long does it take to launch an AI call agent?
Most agents go live in under three weeks. Prebuilt templates for sales, support, and scheduling speed up deployment.
Can I use my existing phone numbers and telephony system?
Yes. ElevenLabs integrates with SIP trunking, Twilio, Genesys, and 200+ providers to work with your current setup.
Will AI call agents replace my human team?
No. They handle repetitive, high-volume interactions, freeing staff to focus on high-value conversations.
What languages are supported?
Agents support 32+ languages with automatic in-conversation switching, ensuring global reach.
How much does it cost?
Pricing is usage-based, starting from per-minute rates for outbound and inbound calls. Contact sales for an ROI estimate tailored to your call volumes.
How do AI agents ensure compliance and security?
AI call agents can be configured to follow calling regulations like TCPA and GDPR, and enterprise deployments include SOC 2, HIPAA, and EU data residency support. Features like zero-retention mode and encrypted storage ensure sensitive data is secure.
Do AI agents replace human call center staff?
Not entirely. They’re designed to handle repetitive, high-volume interactions and free humans for complex or sensitive conversations. Businesses often see the best results with a hybrid model — AI for scale and humans for nuance.
How quickly can I deploy an AI call agent?
Most teams launch in days. With prebuilt integrations and low-code workflow tools, you can set up both inbound and outbound call flows quickly, then scale up to thousands of concurrent calls.
What ROI can I expect from AI call agents?
Companies typically see faster response times, reduced cost per call, and higher customer satisfaction. Some report 66% lower call costs, 60% more efficient collections, and major boosts in conversion rates.

Frequently asked questions
What is a Voice AI SDR agent?
A Voice AI SDR agent is a sales-focused AI voice agent that automates outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification. It can place calls, engage prospects, answer FAQs, and schedule meetings — all with natural, human-like conversation quality.
How do AI phone agents help with outbound sales?
They run large-scale, compliant outreach campaigns — from cold calling to renewals and lead re-engagement. With voicemail detection, batch calling, and real-time responsiveness, they maximize connect rates while keeping costs low.
Can AI SDR agents qualify leads automatically?
Yes. They ask qualifying questions, capture responses, and update your CRM in real time. High-intent leads can be routed directly to human reps or booked into meetings instantly.
Do AI sales agents integrate with CRMs and sales tools?
Absolutely. They connect to Salesforce, HubSpot, and other platforms to log calls, update lead status, and trigger workflows — ensuring every prospect interaction is tracked and actionable.
Will AI SDR agents replace human sales reps?
No. AI agents handle the repetitive top-of-funnel tasks, allowing human SDRs to focus on nurturing relationships and closing deals. This hybrid approach improves efficiency while keeping sales human where it matters.
How do AI agents ensure compliance in outbound calling?
Voice AI SDRs can be configured to follow TCPA, GDPR, and regional dialing laws. They manage opt-outs, enforce disclosures, and provide audit-ready call logs.
Can AI sales agents work in multiple languages?
Yes. AI agents support 70+ languages with automatic detection and real-time switching. This makes them ideal for global outbound campaigns and international sales teams.
How quickly can I launch an AI phone agent?
Most teams get started in days. With prebuilt integrations and low-code campaign tools, you can run pilots quickly and scale to thousands of calls once campaigns prove effective.
What ROI can I expect from Voice AI SDR agents?
Companies typically see faster speed-to-lead, higher qualification rates, and lower cost per call. Some report cutting average handle time from 15 minutes to 2 minutes, while boosting conversion and revenue impact.

Frequently asked questions
What is AI sales training?
AI sales training uses artificial intelligence to help sales reps practice conversations, receive personalized feedback, and identify skill gaps at scale. Instead of relying on manager roleplays or classroom sessions, reps train on-demand with AI buyer personas and get instant coaching on their pitch, discovery, and objection handling.
How is AI sales training different from traditional sales training?
Traditional training is typically one-size-fits-all, manager-dependent, and hard to scale. And reps forget most of it within 90 days. AI sales training delivers personalized practice and feedback continuously, so skills compound rather than decay. It also gives managers data on exactly where each rep is weak.
How realistic are the AI roleplays?
The AI buyer personas are trained on real sales call data and your company's ICP, objections, and messaging. They push back, ask follow-up questions, go off-script, and adapt based on how the rep performs, mimicking how a real prospect would behave on a live call.
Can I customize the AI to match our product, personas, and sales methodology?
Yes. You upload your product docs, call recordings, ICP definitions, and qualification framework (MEDDIC, SPIN, BANT, Challenger, or custom). The AI generates personas and scenarios specific to your business and grades reps against your playbook.
What skills can reps practice?
Cold calling, discovery, qualification, demo delivery, objection handling, negotiation, closing, upsell/cross-sell conversations, and handoff calls. You can also build drills for product knowledge checks and competitive positioning.
Does this replace human sales managers?
No. AI sales training handles the repetitive, scalable parts of coaching so managers can focus on high-impact 1:1s, strategy, and deal reviews. Teams typically see managers spending more quality coaching time, not less.
Can reps practice on mobile?
Yes. Browser and mobile are both supported, including voice roleplays so reps can practice cold calls hands-free between meetings.

What is an AI-powered attorney answering service?
An AI-powered attorney answering service uses conversational voice agents to handle inbound calls on behalf of a law firm. Qualifying leads, collecting intake details, scheduling consultations, and escalating urgent matters. Can the AI agent handle client intake and conflict screening?
Yes. Agents can be configured to walk callers through structured intake questions. Collecting case details, contact information, and conflict-check data before the first attorney interaction. Details are logged directly to your CRM or practice management system in real time.
Is the platform HIPAA-compliant?
ElevenAgents supports HIPAA-ready deployments with a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) available, zero retention mode for sensitive data, end-to-end encryption, and regional data residency options. Which legal software integrations are supported?
ElevenAgents connects to practice management and scheduling tools including Clio, MyCase, Calendly, and other platforms via API. The platform also integrates with CRM systems and supports custom integrations through MCP and our REST API.
What languages does the AI attorney answering service support?
ElevenAgents supports 70+ languages with consistent voice quality and natural tone across all of them. This allows law firms to serve diverse client populations without separate staffing or vendor arrangements for multilingual coverage.
How quickly can a law firm get started?
Most firms can configure and deploy a basic AI-powered answering agent within a day using the ElevenAgents platform. More complex deployments. Such as multi-attorney routing, CRM integration, or custom intake flows. Are supported by our Forward Deployed Engineers from day one.

Frequently asked questions
How do agents connect to our property management system?
We provide prebuilt connectors and APIs for common PMS and booking engines. Integrations keep inventory, rates, and guest profiles synchronized - preventing conflicts and enabling accurate transaction handling.
Can agents handle restaurant bookings and POS interactions?
Yes. Agents integrate with restaurant reservation systems and POS to confirm availability, place orders, and reconcile bills while preserving transaction integrity.
How quickly can we launch an agent across hotels or properties?
You can launch a pilot in weeks. We prioritize core flows - check-in, reservations, and guest requests - then scale across properties with templates, region-specific voices, and policy guardrails.
What security and compliance controls are available?
ElevenAgents supports encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access, audit logs, and options for regional data residency. We also provide validation tooling to enforce payment, privacy, and local regulatory requirements.
Do non-technical teams need engineering support?
No. Operations and guest experience teams can configure and improve agents via our UI. Engineering support is available for deeper integrations and custom workflows.

Frequently asked questions
How fast can I set up a law firm answering service?
Most firms are fully live within days. We help configure your scripts, integrations, and security settings so your AI agent performs accurately from day one.
Can the AI handle conflict checks and legal intake?
Yes. Agents can ask screening questions, capture required data, and flag potential conflicts for human review before scheduling consultations.
What integrations are supported?
We support legal tools like Clio, MyCase, PracticePanther, and Zapier, as well as calendar, CRM, and payment systems.
How is client data protected?
All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. You can enable zero-retention mode, EU data residency, or on-premise options for maximum compliance.
What if I still need a human receptionist sometimes?
You can set hybrid routing so calls can escalate to your human team when needed. The AI passes full context and call history so no information is lost.

Frequently asked questions
How can a virtual receptionist help my small business?
AI receptionists answer every call, greet customers professionally, and handle scheduling or basic questions. This ensures you never miss a call, even outside business hours, and frees your team to focus on core work instead of constant interruptions.
Is this service affordable for small businesses?
Yes. AI answering services cost far less than hiring a full-time receptionist. You only pay for usage, making it flexible and scalable as your business grows.
Can I customize how the AI greets callers?
Absolutely. You can choose the voice, tone, and greeting style to match your brand. Many small businesses create a consistent, professional first impression by tailoring the AI receptionist to sound like part of their team.
Will the AI be able to handle scheduling and messages?
Yes. The virtual receptionist can book appointments, manage calendars, and take detailed messages. It can also send notifications or log details into your CRM so you never lose track of a customer inquiry.
Can it support multiple languages for my customers?
Yes. The AI can converse in 30+ languages and even switch mid-conversation, making it ideal for small businesses that serve diverse communities.
Does it replace human staff?
No. The AI receptionist takes care of routine, high-volume calls and ensures nothing slips through the cracks. When needed, it can transfer customers to a human team member with full context.
How secure is the system for customer data?
Enterprise-grade security features are included, such as encryption, GDPR compliance, and optional zero-retention mode. Even small businesses benefit from the same protections trusted by large enterprises.
How quickly can I set up a virtual receptionist?
Most small businesses can launch within a few days. Setup is simple, with out-of-the-box integrations for calendars, CRMs, and phone systems.
What kind of results can I expect?
Small businesses typically see fewer missed calls, more booked appointments, and higher customer satisfaction. Some report resolving calls 50% faster and doubling first-contact resolution rates.

What is a virtual call center agent?
A virtual call center agent is an AI-powered voice agent that handles both inbound and outbound calls. It can resolve routine requests like billing or order tracking, deflect FAQs, and transfer complex issues to human agents with full context.
How do AI agents improve customer experience in contact centers?
They reduce hold times, provide instant answers 24/7, and deliver consistent service across all calls. By handling repetitive tasks, AI agents free up human staff to focus on nuanced, high-value interactions.
Can AI contact-center agents work alongside my existing systems?
Yes. They integrate with CRMs, telephony providers like Twilio or SIP systems, and support desks. This allows them to log tickets, fetch account details, and update records automatically.
How do AI agents scale during peak call volumes?
AI call center agents can manage thousands of calls simultaneously without adding staff. This makes them especially valuable during seasonal spikes, product launches, or unexpected surges.
Do AI contact-center agents support multiple languages?
Yes. They can converse in 70+ languages and switch mid-conversation. This enables global contact centers to serve diverse customer bases without setting up separate queues.
How secure is customer data when using AI call center agents?

Will AI replace my human contact center staff?
No. AI agents complement existing teams by automating repetitive, high-volume interactions. When needed, calls are seamlessly handed off to human agents, who get the full conversation history so customers don’t need to repeat themselves.
How quickly can I deploy AI-powered call center agents?
Most organizations can launch within days. With prebuilt integrations, workflow design tools, and SDKs, you can start with targeted use cases like FAQ deflection and scale to full inbound/outbound coverage.
What kind of ROI can I expect from AI call center automation?
Businesses typically report faster resolution times, lower cost per call, and higher CSAT. Some have seen a 35% increase in first-call conversions and up to 66% savings on call handling costs.

Frequently asked questions
What is an AI voice generator?
An AI voice generator uses artificial intelligence to convert written text into natural-sounding speech. Unlike robotic TTS systems, ElevenLabs creates voices with realistic intonation, emotion, and human-like delivery by understanding context and meaning.
What makes ElevenLabs voices so realistic?
Our proprietary AI models understand not just what words to say, but how to say them—capturing emotional inflection, natural pauses, and contextual emphasis. We were the first company to achieve truly human-like text-to-speech.
How does the free plan work?
Get 10,000 characters/month free—no credit card required. Access core voices for personal projects. Upgrade anytime for more characters, premium voices, voice cloning, and commercial usage rights.
Can I clone my own voice?
Yes! Create a digital replica of any voice from just a few minutes of audio. Voice cloning is available on paid plans and requires consent verification to prevent misuse.
Which languages are supported?
70+ languages including English (US, UK, AU), Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, Arabic, and many more—all with native-quality pronunciation.
Can I use AI voices commercially?
Yes! Paid plans include commercial usage rights for YouTube, podcasts, ads, audiobooks, games, apps, and any other commercial content. Free tier is for personal use only.
Is there an API for developers?
Yes—comprehensive APIs for TTS, STT, Voice Cloning, Voice Changer, and Conversational AI. Python & TypeScript SDKs, detailed docs, GDPR & SOC II compliant. Start with 5 lines of code.
How fast is voice generation?
Standard generation: 1-3 seconds. Flash v2.5 model: sub-200ms latency for real-time apps like conversational AI and live streaming.

Frequently asked questions
What is the ElevenLabs Ambassador Program?
A program for people who want to help the world discover what is possible with ElevenLabs - by hosting events, creating content, or both. Ambassadors get early access, perks, and direct support from the ElevenLabs team.
Who can apply?
Anyone 18 or older with an active ElevenLabs account, a genuine community or audience, and a real plan to contribute.

What are the two ways to participate?
Community Builder: you organize local ElevenLabs events (meetups, hackathons, workshops, and more)
Content Creator: you produce and publish content about ElevenLabs to your audience (tutorials, demos, reviews, workflows). You can apply for both.
Do I need to already be using ElevenLabs?
Yes. We ask for your account email and to share something you have made with ElevenLabs.

What do Ambassadors get?
Perks depend on how you contribute and how active you are, but include: platform credits, early feature access, event funding, merch, support, and invitations to ElevenLabs events. This is a community program, not a paid role - though Content Creators can unlock paid opportunities over time.
Can I apply for both tracks?
Yes. If you want to host events and create content, select 'Both' in the application form. You will answer questions for each track.
How does the application process work?
Fill out the form. The form adapts based on your track. If your application moves forward, we will schedule a short 15-minute intro call.
Can I be a Content Creator Ambassador and still join the Affiliates program?
Yes. The Ambassador Program and the ElevenLabs Affiliates program are separate. You can participate in both independently.
What happens after I am accepted?
You will receive a welcome email with everything you need: your onboarding playbook, Discord invite, platform credits, and merch claim link. From there, you contribute according to your track.
How do I organize my first event as an ambassador?
Once accepted, you will receive an event playbook with all the information to start organizing your first event.
How do I get started as a Content Creator ambassador?
Once accepted, you will receive a content creation playbook with all the information to start creating your first piece of content.

Frequently asked questions
What is the ElevenLabs API?
The ElevenLabs API provides programmatic access to our AI models for voice, music, sound effects, dubbing, and transcription. You can integrate these capabilities directly into your applications, workflows, and production pipelines.
Which APIs are available?
Text to Speech (TTS): Turns text into lifelike audio with nuanced intonation, pacing, and emotional awareness.
Speech to Text (Transcription): Turns spoken audio into text with state-of-the-art accuracy.
Music: Generate music from text.
Studio: Manage ElevenLabs Studio projects via API.
Text to Dialogue: Create natural-sounding dialogue from text.
Voice Changer: Replace one voice with another.
Voice Isolator (Audio Isolation): Isolate vocal tracks from background noise in audio.
Dubbing: Dub audio and videos seamlessly (translate and voice-over content in other languages).
Sound Effects: Create cinematic sound effects from text descriptions.
Voice Design: Create custom AI voices from text prompts when a needed voice isn’t available in the library.
Voice Remixing: Transform and enhance existing voices (remix voice characteristics or style).
Forced Alignment: Align text to audio (get precise word-level timestamps for given audio and transcript).
Pronunciation Dictionaries: Customize how specific words or phrases are pronounced by TTS models (upload lexicon files to control pronunciation).
Audio Native: An embeddable audio player that automatically voices webpage content using ElevenLabs TTS service.
Agents Platform (Voice Agents): Deploy intelligent voice agents for interactive applications. These endpoints support building, launching, and managing AI-driven voice agents (with components like conversations, knowledge bases, phone integration).
What can I build with the API?
Common use cases include content localization pipelines, automated video production, conversational interfaces, accessibility tools, and training content generation. The API is designed for both real-time and batch processing.
How does authentication work?
All API requests require an API key passed in the xi-api-key header. Keys are generated in your account settings and can be scoped to specific workspaces.
What are the usage limits?
Usage limits vary by plan and endpoint. PAYG usage is enabled from our Starter plan and above.
Do you provide SDKs?
Yes. Official SDKs are available for Python & JavaScript/TypeScript, and additional platforms like Flutter, Swift, and Kotlin for our Agents platform.
How is usage metered?
Text to Speech is billed per character. Speech to Text is billed per audio minute. Music and Sound Effects are billed per generation. Dubbing is billed per source audio minute.
Can I use custom voices via API?
Yes. You can reference any voice in your library by ID, including professional voices, cloned voices, and voices you've designed.
Is the API content safe for commercial use?
Yes. Content generated through the API using ElevenLabs models is commercially licensed. Music requires an additional license for advertising, film, TV, games, and enterprise distribution.
What latency should I expect?
Text to Speech typically responds in under 500ms for streaming. Speech to Text processes at 20-50x real-time depending on file size. Dubbing and Music are batch operations with processing times proportional to content length.
Do you support streaming?
Yes. Text to Speech and Speech to Text both support streaming output, allowing you to use the APIs in real-time applications.
How do I handle errors?
The API returns standard HTTP status codes. Rate limit errors return 429. Invalid requests return 400 with error details. Authentication failures return 401.
Where can I find API documentation?
Complete API reference, code examples, and integration guides are available at elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference
Do you offer enterprise support?
Yes. Enterprise plans include dedicated support, SLAs, custom rate limits, SSO, SOC 2 compliance, and MSAs.

Tools like ElevenLabs offer flexible, high-quality voices that fit different formats and styles.
Overview
Text to speech technology is changing the way creators approach content. With just a few clicks, written material can be transformed into natural-sounding audio that resonates with a broader audience. From enhancing accessibility to unlocking new formats, this tool is becoming an irreplaceable part of modern digital communication.
Why are creators so excited about advanced text to speech tools?
At its core, the growing popularity of
text to speech
comes down to flexibility and efficiency.
Content creators no longer need to rely on expensive voiceover sessions or spend hours editing audio. Instead, they can instantly generate professional-quality narration that matches their tone and intent. In addition to saving time, this shift also opens up new creative possibilities.
For audiences, however,
text to speech is all about convenience
. Audio allows users to engage with content while doing other things, like commuting, exercising, or working. It also makes content more accessible to those with reading difficulties or visual impairments. And for brands, it offers a way to present a consistent voice across platforms (literally).
If you’re wondering how to jump on the TTS bandwagon and avoid getting left behind, here are ten creative ways to use text to speech in your content today:
1. Turn blog posts into narrated audio
Giving your blog a voice makes it more versatile and accessible.
Instead of asking readers to sit down and scroll, you offer them the option to listen while they drive, walk, or work (given their job permits it). It’s particularly useful for long-form content, where attention spans often wane on screen.
Narrated blogs can also be repurposed into audio summaries, embedded in newsletters, or shared as standalone pieces. Turning your content into audio adds longevity and invites users to revisit it in new ways. With ElevenLabs, creators can match the tone of their narration to their brand, ranging from casual to professional, upbeat, or calm.
2. Create audio versions of newsletters
Email remains one of the most direct ways to reach your audience, but it’s often consumed quickly or ignored altogether. Adding an audio component immediately gives you a competitive advantage (or at least additional creativity points).
Instead of skimming through text, readers can press play and absorb your latest updates, stories, or offers in real time. This idea is especially helpful for long or storytelling-style newsletters.
A narrated version can make the experience feel more personal, like a voice memo from your brand. It also increases accessibility and creates more opportunities for your content to be shared across platforms.
3. Build audio snippets for social media
Attention spans on social media are short, and scrolling is a constant activity. Audio snippets add variety to your feed and stop the scroll with something different.
Tackle decreasing attention spans head-on by
using text to speech to narrate a quote, summarize a tip, or voice a headline
. Pair it with visual elements, like animation, b-roll, or static images, to create short, punchy content that’s ready to post.
This approach is great for repurposing existing content. A blog post can become a series of voiced social clips. A product description can be read aloud with music and motion. Ultimately, it’s a way to extract more value from your work without having to create everything from scratch.
4. Develop bite-sized audio explainers
Speaking of shorter attention spans, not every piece of audio content needs to be long. Sometimes, a 30-second explainer is all your audience needs.
These short voiceovers can be used to define terms, answer common questions, or guide users through features. They’re especially effective on landing pages, help centers, and product walkthroughs.
With text to speech, you can record these on demand without scripting or studio time. Just type out your message, select a voice that matches the tone, and you’re done. It’s a great way to improve user experience and reduce friction in the customer journey.
5. Repurpose articles into mini-podcasts
If you’re regularly writing articles or thought leadership pieces, text to speech can help you turn that content into podcast-style episodes. In addition to expanding your distribution, this clever twist also appeals to listeners who prefer audio over reading.
Each article becomes an opportunity to connect with your audience in a new way. You can publish these narrated articles on your blog, embed them in email campaigns, or syndicate them to podcast platforms. Add intro and outro
music
for a professional touch, and you’ve got a scalable audio strategy that requires minimal effort to maintain.
6. Add narration to online courses
Online learners prefer content that is engaging, clear, and easy to follow. Voice narration enhances that experience by
guiding users through lessons
, explaining key points, and reinforcing essential takeaways. It’s invaluable in self-paced or asynchronous learning environments, where students don’t have a live instructor.
Text to speech allows course creators to update and expand modules quickly, without re-recording hours of audio. You can generate voiceovers for new sections, switch tones based on the subject, or create multilingual versions to cater to global learners. It’s efficient and highly adaptable.
7. Create character voices for storytelling
Story-driven content comes alive when characters have distinct voices. Text to speech tools like ElevenLabs allow creators to craft
unique vocal identities, adjusting pitch, tone, speed, and emotion
to match the personality of each character.
This option is ideal for fiction writers, video game developers, or YouTubers who want to narrate dialogue without hiring multiple actors. You can add dramatic flair to stories, create different voices for narration and characters, and even build interactive audio experiences with branching paths or dynamic responses. The possibilities are as limitless as your imagination.
8. Build custom voice assistants or chatbots
If your product includes a virtual assistant or conversational interface, a voice adds a new layer of depth.
Text to speech gives that assistant a personality, ranging from friendly to formal, playful, or professional. This addition helps users connect with your tool more naturally, especially in voice-first environments like
mobile app
s or smart devices.
With the right voice and tone, your assistant can
provide directions, answer questions, or deliver reminders
in a way that feels intuitive and personal. ElevenLabs also allows developers to create multilingual assistants with consistent performance across languages.
9. Add voice to training and onboarding content
Onboarding materials are often overlooked or skimmed through, especially when they’re dense or text-heavy. Adding voice narration makes this content more digestible. You can walk users through features, summarize policies, or explain systems with greater clarity and warmth.
This application works well in both employee onboarding and customer education. Using text to speech ensures consistency across departments and updates, allowing you to revise messaging without having to re-record audio each time something changes. It’s scalable, repeatable, and easier to implement than traditional voiceover workflows.
10. Bring accessibility to all formats
One of the most important reasons to use text to speech is to
make your content more inclusive
. Not everyone can easily read a blog post, follow an email, or engage with visual design. Adding a voice option makes your content usable for people with visual impairments, learning differences, or cognitive fatigue.
Accessibility should be a core part of any content strategy, and incorporating TTS is one of the easiest ways to get started. By offering voice alongside your written material, you show that you value every user’s experience and are committed to making your content available to all.
Final thoughts
Text to speech has evolved far beyond its original robotic sound (sorry, Microsoft Sam).
On the contrary, TTS has become a creative tool that empowers content creators to connect in new, flexible, and powerful ways. It helps you reach people where they are, in the format they prefer, without extra overhead or production costs.
From narrated blogs to accessible learning tools, the applications are only growing. With ElevenLabs, bringing your content to life through voice is as easy as writing it. And in a world where voice is becoming a key part of digital interaction, that’s an opportunity worth exploring.
FAQs
What is text to speech?
Text to speech is a tool that converts written words into spoken audio. It’s used to narrate content, create dialogue, and add voice to everything from blogs and videos to apps and digital tools.
How can I use text to speech for my content?
You can use it to turn blog posts into audio, voice your social media content, create character dialogue, narrate courses, and more. TTS helps repurpose content while saving time and money on manual recording.
Do text to speech tools provide enough quality for professional use?
Yes. Platforms like ElevenLabs offer professional-grade voices with natural pacing, emotional control, and realistic delivery, making them suitable for business, education, and entertainment.
Can I clone my own voice with ElevenLabs?
Yes. ElevenLabs allows you to create a custom voice model from your own recordings, so you can generate new content in your own voice without having to record each time.
Is text to speech important for accessibility?
Absolutely. Text to speech helps make content available to users who have visual impairments, dyslexia, or prefer audio learning. It’s one of the simplest ways to improve digital accessibility.

What comes next
In November 2025, voice creators on the ElevenLabs Voice Library had earned $11 million. Six months later, that number has doubled to over $22 million.
There are now 10,400+ creators earning on the platform, with voices spanning dozens of languages.
Unmute
voice marketplace
A new economic model for voice IP
For voice creators, the standard model has been one-time licensing fees. Record a session, deliver the files, and get paid once.
The Voice Marketplace replaces that with ongoing earnings from usage, on terms the creator sets, with consent and revocation controls built in.
As more content gets generated, the value of an authentic, well-licensed voice grows, and the creators who built the catalog earn from every generation.
The marketplace serves a wide range of creative work
flows
. Radio producers pull voices for station promos and commercials when no one else is in the building. Independent authors produce full-length
audiobooks
with marketplace voices for under $100 in credits. Game developers cast character voices across archetypes - from villains to narrators to sidekicks - without booking a single studio session. Podcasters, e-learning creators, and marketing teams use marketplace voices to scale content across languages and formats they could never staff for on their own. A single voice becomes a persistent asset that works across use cases, geographies, and time zones - and the creator earns every time it gets used.
The acceleration in payouts to $22 million reflects growing demand for this model, from a global community of voice creators and millions of customers.
How the marketplace works
A voice creator uploads a Professional
Voice Clone
, the highest-fidelity clone available on ElevenLabs. They set the terms under which their voice can be licensed: which use cases it can be used for, the price tier, and the notice period (up to two years). The voice is then reviewed by the ElevenLabs team for safety and policy compliance - including checks for naming guidelines, child safety, slurs, hate speech, and celebrity references - before it becomes available in the Voice Library.
Once live, the voice is discoverable through search, handpicked collections, and filters for certain languages, accents, categories, genders, ages, and qualities. Customers can also find voices by uploading an audio file to match against similar voices on the platform. When another ElevenLabs customer generates with that voice, the creator earns. Earnings are calculated based on usage and the terms the creator set.
The range of voices reflects the range of people behind them. The catalog includes late night announcers, rugged cowboys, sinister villains, quirky mad scientists, warm narrators, and animated cartoon characters - each one uploaded by a real creator who set their own licensing terms. For creators and marketers looking for the right voice, the marketplace functions as an instant casting library across styles, languages, and tones, without the overhead of booking studio sessions or negotiating individual licensing deals.
Importantly, creators retain control of their voice. They can update their licensing terms, restrict use cases, or remove their voice from the marketplace (with a notice period acting as a buffer for existing users). Every voice in the Voice Library comes with a free commercial use license for the customer using it.
Creator stories
The voices on the Voice Marketplace come from a global community: voice actors with decades of professional work, audiobook narrators, podcasters, radio professionals, language teachers, and emerging creators discovering they have a marketable voice.
Brad Barlow, radio host and voice creator
Brad Barlow is a program director and on-air host at Now 105.1 in Idaho. He has been in radio since he was 16. For years, he dreamt of being a station voice or cartoon voice actor, but every time he looked into it, the path felt gated. "Every time I would start to kind of look into it, I felt like the response I would get was maybe you can do it, but then this laundry list of stuff that would make me go, that doesn't sound fun. I just want to do it."
When he discovered the Voice Marketplace, he uploaded his voice and started creating characters - each one with a specific persona and backstory. He now has 20 voices live on the platform. For his top voice, Brad Clear Narrator for Documentary, he "wanted it to sound like somebody that was a real person that you could hang out with. And that's what I wanted it to do."
For Brad, the marketplace has been more than a side project. ElevenLabs now touches nearly every piece of audio he produces at the station - from commercials and promos to station identifiers. He uses a rotating cast of voices rather than a single station voice, pulling from the Voice Library to match the creative need of each project. "For people like me who don't have a staff, who are doing it by themselves - now we can make our stuff sound just as cool, just as big time, just as legit."
He has also become one of the platform's most vocal community members, and even demoed the product live at Author Nation in Las Vegas, generating audiograms for authors who had never heard their work read aloud.
"If ElevenLabs has caused any problem for me, it is my sleep quality - because I will wake up at two or three in the morning with an idea that I can't wait to go make."
Jessica Anne Bogart, voice actor and voice creator
Jessica Anne Bogart has voiced characters in some of the most-watched animated series of the last two decades. She was the first professional actor to join the Voice Marketplace under her real name, embracing the technology and giving independent creators direct access to her voice.
"I didn't want to hedge or hide behind an alias. I wanted to show up as myself and give creators access to my voice - no
agents
, no middlemen, no gatekeeping."
She uploaded three distinct tones, and usage grew quickly. The growth changed the math on what a voice career could look like. In the time since joining the platform, she has earned more from the Voice Marketplace than from the previous five years of her acting career combined.
The platform has also generated work that would never have come through traditional channels. Creators who discovered her voice through the marketplace have reached out directly to book custom recording sessions - projects that started with an AI-generated draft and led to a live studio relationship.
"ElevenLabs gave me a new understanding of what it means to be a voiceover artist right now. This isn't a threat to the craft. It's an expansion of it. More people hear your voice, more people want to work with you, and the work finds you in ways it never did before."
Simon Patrick, audiobook producer and voice creator
Simon Patrick was one of the earliest users of ElevenLabs - user 202 on the original Discord, back when the ElevenLabs team was eight people. When his daughter Abby dropped out of college at 17 to write her first novel, Simon became her publisher. The books did well, but audiobook production was out of reach at $3,000+ per title.
When our first
Text to Speech
model was made available in beta in February 2023, Simon used ChatGPT to break Abby's 70,000-word manuscript into 5,000-character chunks and fed them into the platform one by one. That first paragraph back was the moment he knew. "She heard this first line and the first paragraph and she started to cry because it was delivering it the way she'd always imagined it being read."
His voice, Christopher, is a popular British male voice on the platform, and he earns a full-time living from it. His daughter Abby's voice, Amelia, one of the top voices on the platform, has earned income that allowed her to quit her day job and write full-time. She is now on her seventh published book.
"Authors often come to me who have dyslexic readers, partially sighted readers, who can now access their stories because a voice on ElevenLabs reads them to them," Simon says. "This is not generative AI. This is performative AI. It is taking stories and putting them into a format that more people can access."
Global voices, better representation
The marketplace model also improves the diversity of voice AI. By enabling creators from around the world to contribute their voices, the Voice Library has a wide catalog of voices in 32 languages, and dozens of accents and styles.
As well as showcasing the incredible range of human speech, the marketplace also helps meet demand from every part of the world. India is one of our fastest-growing creator markets. Creators and marketers producing content in Hindi and Indian English find the voices they need on the marketplace, and Indian voice talent is earning meaningfully on the platform.
What comes next
Our goal is to keep growing the Voice Marketplace and the community that benefits from it. We will add more voices in more languages, and help more creators to earn.
We are also building out the infrastructure that supports voice creators: better discovery for their voices, better analytics on how their voices are being used, and continued investment in the consent and control tooling that makes the marketplace trustworthy.
The success of the Voice Marketplace inspired us to bring the same model to music. The
Music
Marketplace launched in March with the same architecture, and we are exploring ways to expand this model across ElevenCreative.
If you want to license your voice on the marketplace,
get started today
.

3Shape provides dental scanning technology and a software ecosystem that helps dental professionals digitalize their workflows and achieve better patient outcomes. They serve customers in over 100 countries, and their technology is used to scan more than 25 million patients each year. To serve their global customer base, 3Shape’s support organization assists dental professionals across phone, email, and chat.
Unmute
To further improve response times and extend global availability, 3Shape deployed ElevenAgents across two channels:
AI web widget:
A chat and voice agent embedded across 3Shape's core websites, handling common questions, troubleshooting, and surfacing relevant knowledge resources.
Omnichannel support agent:
A conversational agent to provide first-line support and route cases to specialists when needed.
Both are designed to make customer support faster and more consistent without sacrificing quality and keeping 3Shape's human experts involved in complex cases.
Meeting customers where they are
Voice is the primary channel 3Shape's customers reach for when they need help. As voice remains the primary support channel for many customers, 3Shape focused on delivering a natural and transparent support experience.
3Shape built transparency into the experience from the start. Users always know they are interacting with AI, and they always have the option to escalate to a human. ElevenAgents' research-backed voice models, including advanced turn-taking and interruption handling, helped deliver the natural conversational quality their customers expect.
The agents handle common questions, walk customers through troubleshooting, surface relevant knowledge resources, and hand off to specialists when needed.
Empathetic tone and a human-like feel are super important in support. We want to ensure that our customers feel understood and not processed.
- Jannes Koopmann, Sr. AI Business Owner, 3Shape
Moving quickly from concept to production
3Shape evaluated multiple vendors. The priority was finding a platform where they could demo against real use cases and reach production quickly without sacrificing quality.
Configuring end-to-end workflows, refining tone of voice, and ensuring consistent conversation steering all happened within the platform. Because ElevenAgents is configurable across models, voices, and deployment channels, 3Shape's team could iterate without waiting on a vendor services team.
The 3Shape team does ongoing QA by reviewing transcripts and call flows directly in ElevenLabs, catching edge cases and improving agent behavior against actual production conversations.
We selected ElevenLabs because we had the confidence that we could get to a solution faster and at the quality that we're aiming for. We needed to easily configure agents, test them against real interactions and edge cases, and add the tooling and guardrails to bring them into production.
- Jannes Koopmann, Sr. AI Business Owner, 3Shape
Why ElevenLabs
3Shape chose ElevenAgents for voice quality, speed to production, and built-in tooling for iteration and control. Key factors included:
Vertically integrated stack:
All models and orchestration are co-located in ElevenAgents, eliminating network hops to deliver industry-leading latency and human-like voice quality.
Omnichannel deployment:
3Shape launched both web widget and phone from a single platform configuration.
Guardrails and conversation steering:
Consistent agent behavior across thousands of weekly interactions, with built-in tools for transcript review and call flow analysis.
Future-proof:
Every model improvement lands automatically, with no replatforming required.
Impact and results
3Shape's focus has been on delivering customer outcomes rather than automating for automation's sake. The agents increasingly give customers access to 24/7 support across web and phone channels, with a consistent, human-like experience and a clear path to a human specialist when needed.
ElevenAgents helped us deliver better customer experiences. Our customers can access support instantly, get answers quicker, and resolve issues outside of working hours.
- Jannes Koopmann, Sr. AI Business Owner, 3Shape
What's next
3Shape is continuing to continuously improve agent performance based on customer interactions. The team is focused on deepening resolution capabilities and extending AI-assisted support across additional workflows.

The importance of a good mentor has been emphasized throughout many professions and industries, and voice acting is no exception. Regardless of how long you've been in the game, an experienced coach can help you reach new milestones in your voice acting career and build on your existing talent and skill set.
In this article, we take a look at some of the best voice acting coaches in the industry and the spheres of voiceover coaching in which they specialize in. But before we begin, let's get acquainted with what a voice acting coach does and what benefits they offer to voiceover artists.
What is a voice acting coach?
A voice acting coach is someone who specializes in training voice actors to find their niche in the industry (e.g., audiobook narration, animation voiceovers, commercial voiceovers, etc.), develop their voice over skills, learn proper technique, and gain confidence. These goals are achieved through vocal training sessions, exercises, and feedback.
Similar to a vocal coaching program for budding
music
artists, experienced voiceover coaches can help industry newbies find their footing in a competitive environment and hone their skills.
From proper diction to breathing to correct pronunciation, voice acting coaching sessions can help even the most naturally gifted voice actors improve their skills and reach new heights regarding their careers and voice talent.
Who needs a voice coach?
Although voice actors with varying degrees of experience can benefit from professional voice coaching sessions, voice coaches are usually recommended to newbies or beginner voice actors.
Sure, there are a couple of alternatives to private sessions, like tutorials or video guides, but nothing beats personalized coaching - both in terms of results and learning speed.
Additionally, most voice coaches usually have extensive experience in the field themselves, allowing them to share valuable industry knowledge with their students. This experience also allows coaches to help students discover their own niches and clearly understand what type of voice acting work to focus on.
From commercial voice acting to character voices, one-on-one voice coaching and group sessions can be excellent additions to any promising voice actor's schedule.
The benefits of working with a professional voice acting coach
Whether you want to brush up on your diction or clarity, improve your technique, or learn to embody different characters, an experienced voice over coach can help guide you through the steps required to achieve your personal milestones.
Let's explore some of the key benefits of working with a professional voice acting coach in more detail.
Develop your technical skills
Voice acting may be considered a creative niche, but it can also get quite technical. From general vocal technique to pronunciation to breathing control, an experienced voiceover coach will help you improve your performance skills.
Get into character
Whether you're looking to get into anime
dubbing
, video game voiceovers, or audiobook narration, it's essential to be able to embody different characters and convey their personalities with just your voice. A voice acting coach can help you develop unique voices for specific characters and ace every creative gig.
Interpret your scripts
Script interpretation is paramount for a successful voice acting career, but this skill takes time and practice to perfect. An experienced voice acting coach can speed up your progress by assisting you with understanding your scripts, character motivations, and how to convey meaning through your voice.
Receive professional feedback
Although receiving criticism (albeit constructive) may not be everyone's favorite part of the learning process, it's one of the most critical aspects. Choosing an experienced and dedicated coach will give you regular feedback on your performance and areas for improvement.
Build your confidence
Working with a professional voice acting coach isn't just about enhancing your skills - it's also about building your confidence! While working with a coach can boost your confidence in your overall performance abilities, a good coach will also be your number-one cheerleader and support you throughout your journey.
Gain valuable industry insights
You may have heard the saying, "Coaches don't play," but this quote doesn't apply to voice coaches.
Most professional coaches possess extensive experience as voice actors, voiceover artists, and narrators. They can share valuable industry knowledge with you and even give tips on how to market yourself and book gigs.
Discover your niche
While some voice actors may be animation voiceover gurus, others discover that their talents lie in audiobook narration or commercial voiceovers. A professional voice coach will help you discover your best niche and focus on areas where your talents shine.
Personalized coaching vs group sessions
Although one-on-one instruction can seem like the most desirable option to develop your voice acting skills, personalized sessions can be pretty pricey, depending on your budget. This is where group sessions come in.
Make no mistake; group sessions can be just as effective as personalized coaching. They allow you to network with other budding voice actors in your area, learn from others in the group, and work with an experienced coach without breaking the bank.
The best voice coaches for voice actors in 2024
Now that we've established how a voice acting coach can help you hone your skills as a voice actor and book more significant projects with better pay, it's time to look at some of the best professionals in the industry.
We've compiled a short list of the top coaches in the game who are guaranteed to take your skills to the next level, provide excellent advice, and work with you to suit your individual requirements and learning style.
Without further ado, let's dive in!
Nancy Wolfson
Known as a legend in voice acting and the private coaching business,
Nancy Wolfson
has over two decades of extensive experience in voiceovers, personalized voice coaching, and demo production. Nancy has helped voice actors worldwide hone their skills, boost their confidence, and make a substantial income off voice acting alone.
Many
agents
and voiceover artists refer to Nancy as the "go-to" coach and demo producer. She offers several coaching options for varying requirements and budgets, including private in-person coaching, study-via-phone programs, audition-specific training sessions, and casting services.
Nancy and her team also specialize in demo production, which is a massive plus for any voice actor looking to establish a name for themselves in the industry.
Terry Daniel
Another highly rated voice acting coach,
Terry Daniel
has established himself as a reliable, experienced, and knowledgeable teacher.
Terry's courses offer everything a voice actor needs, including an introduction to commercial and narration scripts, instructions on developing your technique, guides on using recording software, and even the marketing side of voice acting and self-promotion.
Likewise, Terry works with prospective voice actors to develop commercial and narration demos recorded in a professional studio, helping new talent book reliable, well-paid gigs. He also hosts online group classes, where voice actors can learn in a fun and interactive setting.
Rachel Alena
After working as a voice actor for over two decades,
Rachel Alena
was inspired to create her own voice acting classes after hosting a successful workshop for the agency representing her at the time.
What started as a one-off experience resulted in Rachel discovering her passion for teaching in addition to voice acting, leading her to establish her coaching business.
Rachel provides highly personalized training programs that address her students' individual goals and requirements, starting with a free consultation. Her coaching programs include understanding your voice, choosing your niche, vocal training, tips on setting up a home studio, demo production, and networking.
Jordan Hunter Jones
With extensive experience in voice acting, narration, regular acting, and even stand-up comedy,
Jordan Hunter Jones
is undeniably one of the top coaches in the game.
Jordan combines decades of experience with a fun approach to inspire even the most shy students to come out of their shells, find their voices, and establish themselves in the industry.
If you're looking for a coach who will guide you every step of the way while still being as enthusiastic about voice acting as he was when he first started in the business, Jordan is undeniably your guy!
Kevin Kemp
As a Stanislavski and Meisner-technique-trained actor, director, voiceover artist, and acting coach,
Kevin Kemp
's impressive industry background is ideal for voice actors looking to learn the business while perfecting their technique.
Offering both in-person and private online sessions, Kevin helps voice actors find their place in the industry and develop their unique skills and talents.
He'll guide you through the basics, such as vocal health and stamina, while also teaching you about character voices and different accents, dialects, and phonetics.
And if you're still not 100% sure whether you need voice acting coaching, Kevin offers free consultations to help you decide.
Key takeaways
The verdict on voice acting coaches is in!
A good voice acting coach can help you boost your skills in more ways than one while also providing valuable industry insights, marketing advice, confidence-building techniques, and demo production.
Whether you're just getting started in the industry or feel like you need an extra boost to begin booking better, higher-paying gigs, investing in a good voice acting coach will get you there quicker than relying solely on your efforts.
With a wide variety of voice acting classes and coaches available online, it can be tricky to pick one. However, it's essential to research beforehand, read testimonials, and check experience, prices, and coaching arrangements to choose the best coach for your individual needs, budget, and location.
We hope this article has introduced you to some of the biggest names in the game. Remember, if you're looking to start your career in voice acting, ElevenLabs is a fantastic place to begin. ElevenLabs crosses $500M ARR as it welcomes new investors including BlackRock, NVIDIA, Jamie Foxx and Eva Longoria

Mati
