Questions and answers
Frequently asked questions
How do I add my sound effects to the SFX Explore page?
Navigate to the Sound Effects section and click on the History tab. For each of your previously generated sound effects, you'll see two icons on the right: the first one allows you to download, and the second lets you share it on the Explore page.
How does the Text to Sound Effects model work?
It's simple: just describe the sound you have in mind and we'll generate a few sample sound effects to choose from. You can then upscale the one you like the most, or continue generating until you find the sound effect that works for you.
What are some primary use cases for this technology?
Our model can generate royalty-free sound effects for practically any use case. The sounds are ideal for film production, commercial ads, media, commercials, and video game development. Whether you need
explosion sound effects
,
gunshot SFX
, or background ambience, our extensive free sound effects library makes it easy to find the perfect audio. Additionally, users looking to create custom soundboards for personal or business use can take advantage of our sound effect generator, which lets you design unique sound effects from scratch.

Soundboards are widely used in Discord voice chats, live streaming, and gaming, allowing users to trigger meme sound effects, funny sound effects, and custom SFX in real time. Content creators and video editors can use our platform to download free sound effects or generate original SFX for YouTube videos, podcasts, and social media content.
Can I use ElevenLabs sound effects for commercial projects, YouTube videos, and social media?
Yes! As long as you have a paid account, you can use our sound effects royalty-free in commercial projects, including YouTube videos, social media content, and even advertising (free users may only use the services for non-commercial purposes). We provide high-quality free sound effects for video editing, including
explosion sound effects
,
horror screams
, and
gunshot SFX
. And if you need something completely original, our sound effect generator allows you to create and customize your own sounds from scratch. No copyright worries—just unique, professional-quality sound effects for your content.

However, as with all of our services, we ask that you do not sell or license our tools or use the output to develop competitive products or services. Please refer to our
terms
for more details.
Where can I find free sound effects for my projects, videos and games?
You can browse and download free sound effects for video editing, game development and more from our massive library, featuring everything from
explosion SFX
and
horror screams
to classic meme soundboard effects.
But if you're looking for something unique, our sound effect generator lets you create custom sound effects from scratch. Whether you're editing a video, designing a game, or just need the perfect sound effect button for a prank, you can easily generate, modify, and download your own sounds in MP3 format —all royalty-free.
What are royalty-free sound effects, and where can I get them?
Royalty-free sound effects are sounds that you can use without worrying about copyright restrictions. They're perfect for YouTube videos, podcasts, video games, and other creative projects.

Our platform offers a massive selection of free royalty-free sound effects, covering everything from
explosion sound effects
and
gunshot SFX
to more niche options like
dog bark SFX
and
record player sounds
. Plus, if you want something unique, you can generate your own royalty-free sound effects from scratch using our sound effect generator.

If you're on a paid plan, all our sound effects and royalty-free SFX can be used in commercial projects, including YouTube videos, social media content, and even advertising.
How do I get sound effects buttons for pranks and memes?
Sound effects buttons make it easy to play hilarious sounds with just one tap. Whether you need a
classic fart sound effect
, a loud air horn, or a perfectly timed
cricket sound effect
for awkward moments, we’ve got you covered.

And if you can’t find the perfect sound, no problem - our sound effect generator lets you create your own sound effects and add them to your soundboard buttons. Make custom prank sounds, mix meme SFX, or tweak existing effects to fit your style.

Elevate your chatbot with voice

Turn-taking and interruption handling

Global coverage across 70+ languages

A voice stack tested across millions of real conversations

Speech to Text

Text to Speech
Expressive, human-like voices across 70+ languages. Choose from our 11,000+ voice library or create your own with Voice Cloning.
Turn detection
Knows when the user has finished speaking versus pausing - controlling exactly when the transcript is sent to your LLM.
Interruption handling
Monitors for user speech while the agent is talking. Stops playback and loops back instantly when the user cuts in.
Voice activity detection
Filters speech from background noise at the input level, so only clean audio reaches the transcription model.
Audio orchestration
Manages the full voice lifecycle - from capturing user audio to delivering the agent's spoken response.
Add Speech Engine to your agent with one prompt
Install with one command using our skill. The skill sets up everything you need so you can go from chat to voice in a single prompt.

Frequently asked questions
What LLMs are supported?
Any LLM that produces text. The SDK has built-in stream extraction for OpenAI (Responses API and Chat Completions API), Anthropic Messages API, and Google Gemini API. For other providers, pass a plain string or an async iterable of string chunks.
What is the difference between Speech Engine and ElevenAgents?
ElevenAgents is a fully-hosted platform where ElevenLabs provides the LLM, knowledge base, and tools. Speech Engine is for developers who want to bring their own LLM and control the conversation logic on their own server.
What server frameworks are supported?
In TypeScript, you can attach Speech Engine to any Node.js HTTP server (Express, Fastify, or plain http.createServer()), or run a standalone WebSocket server. In Python, the SDK provides a standalone server via engine.serve(), or you can integrate with FastAPI, Starlette, or any ASGI framework using engine.create_session().

Armenian (hye), Azerbaijani (aze), Bengali (ben), Cantonese (yue), Filipino (fil), Georgian (kat), Gujarati (guj), Hindi (hin), Kazakh (kaz), Lithuanian (lit), Maltese (mlt), Mandarin (cmn), Marathi (mar), Nepali (nep), Odia (ori), Persian (fas), Serbian (srp), Slovenian (slv), Swahili (swa), Tamil (tam) and Telugu (tel).

Afrikaans (afr), Arabic (ara), Assamese (asm), Asturian (ast), Burmese (mya), Hausa (hau), Hebrew (heb), Javanese (jav), Korean (kor), Kyrgyz (kir), Luxembourgish (ltz), Māori (mri), Occitan (oci), Punjabi (pan), Tajik (tgk), Thai (tha), Uzbek (uzb) and Welsh (cym).

Moderate (>20% to ≤50% WER)

Amharic (amh), Ganda (lug), Igbo (ibo), Irish (gle), Khmer (khm), Kurdish (kur), Lao (lao), Mongolian (mon), Northern Sotho (nso), Pashto (pus), Shona (sna), Sindhi (snd), Somali (som), Urdu (urd), Wolof (wol), Xhosa (xho), Yoruba (yor) and Zulu (zul).
What is Speech to Text and how does it work?
Speech-to-text (STT) is a technology that converts spoken language into written text using automatic speech recognition (ASR). It processes audio signals, identifies speech patterns, and transcribes them into text with high accuracy.

ElevenLabs' AI-powered speech-to-text software is designed to transcribe audio and video content with human-like precision, making it ideal for speech-to-text conversion, audio transcription, and real-time speech recognition.

Speech-to-text technology is used in:
✔ Speech-to-text transcription for podcasts, meetings, and interviews.
✔ Captions and subtitles in video content.
✔ Speech-to-text software for hands-free typing and accessibility tools.

ElevenLabs ASR offers fast, reliable, and highly accurate speech-to-text conversion for multiple languages and accents.
How do I transcribe video to text?
ElevenLabs provides video transcription to convert spoken dialogue into text format, making it easy to create subtitles, captions, and searchable transcripts.

Steps to transcribe video to text:
1. Upload your video file to ElevenLabs ASR
2. Speech recognition technology processes the audio
3. A transcript is generated automatically, with timestamps
4. Download the text file or export subtitles for editing.

This AI-powered video transcription model helps content creators, businesses, and educators quickly convert video speech into accurate text for accessibility and content repurposing.
How much does Scribe cost?
Starting from $0.40 per hour of transcribed audio, falling well below this at scale with Enterprise plans.
Can I generate captions for social media videos?
Yes. Scribe can auto-generate captions and subtitles for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and more—supporting multiple languages for accessibility and reach.
What is the most accurate Speech to Text model?
The most accurate Speech to Text models use deep neural networks trained on large, multilingual datasets. Scribe achieves industry-leading accuracy across 90+ languages, outperforming models like Whisper, Deepgram, and Gemini in benchmark tests.
Can Speech to Text work in real time?
Yes. Real-time Speech to Text converts spoken words into text as they’re being spoken. With Scribe v2 Realtime, transcription occurs in under 150 milliseconds, making it ideal for live conversations, meetings, and AI agents.
What can I use Speech to Text for?
Speech to Text can be used for meeting notes, podcasts, accessibility captions, customer service calls, and any task that requires converting spoken content into readable text. It also powers real-time AI assistants and automated workflows.
How secure is Speech to Text transcription?
All Speech to Text data is processed with enterprise-grade security. Transcriptions can be handled through encrypted APIs, and sensitive information can be processed locally or with restricted access to meet compliance standards.
Does Speech to Text work offline?
Speech to Text technology can work offline if models are deployed locally. Scribe supports cloud and on-premise configurations, allowing enterprises to control data handling while maintaining low latency and high accuracy.
Can Speech to Text detect different speakers?
Yes. Advanced Speech to Text systems use speaker diarization to distinguish and label multiple speakers automatically, even in overlapping conversations.
What is the difference between Speech to Text and transcription software?
Speech to Text refers to the automatic process of converting spoken language into text using AI, while transcription software may include editing tools, formatting, and collaboration features built around that core technology.

What is the ElevenLabs Bulk Transcription API?
The Bulk Transcription API is part of Scribe, our Speech to Text system designed for large-scale audio and video transcription. It enables developers and enterprises to process hours of recorded content with industry-leading accuracy across 99 languages.
What types of audio and video files can I upload?
Scribe supports all common formats, including MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV, and more.
How accurate is Scribe for bulk transcription?
Scribe v2 achieves best-in-class accuracy across 99 languages and is robust to challenging audio conditions, accents, and recording quality. It outperforms previous generation models and other leading APIs on public benchmarks.
How long does transcription take for large files?
Processing time depends on file length and concurrency. Scribe is optimized for throughput and can handle large-scale pipelines with high parallelization, delivering transcripts in seconds to minutes.
Does Scribe support speaker separation and timestamps?
Yes. The API provides smart speaker diarization, word- and character-level timestamps, and dynamic audio tagging for non-speech events like laughter or music.
Can I customize the model for domain-specific terms?

Is the Bulk Transcription API secure and compliant?
Scribe supports SOC 2, GDPR, and optional HIPAA compliance. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and teams can enable EU data residency or Zero Retention modes for stricter control.
How is the Bulk Transcription API priced?
Pricing is usage-based, calculated per minute of input audio. Volume discounts and enterprise plans are available for high-throughput workloads. Contact our sales team to discuss your requirements.
How can I get started?
You can start transcribing immediately by generating an API key and exploring the API docs.

Frequently asked questions
What are the eligibility requirements?
Monetized product use case: The goal of the ElevenLabs Grants is to help new and nascent products and business models powered by AI voices take off without too much start up cost. As such, only applications with a business or monetization strategy should apply. Only applications with valid business emails will be considered.

No short-term or one-off projects: Grants will only be awarded to companies seeking to build products they intend to take to market for the long term. One-off projects and campaigns will not be considered.

No projects for minors: We are unable to award grants to companies that are building projects for children aged 18 or under.

Startups and small companies only: The ElevenLabs Grants program is open to all startups or companies with less than 25 employees at the time of receiving the application.

No agencies or consulting firms: Agencies and consulting firms are not eligible for an ElevenLabs Grant.

One application per company: Each company can only submit one application. If you have multiple companies (rock on!) you can submit one application for each company. Existing enterprise customers are not eligible for grants.

Terms of receipt: If awarded a Grant, the company must agree to display "ElevenLabs Grants" logo at the bottom of their website, and include a link to the ElevenLabs website for at least twelve (12) months from the date of grant approval.
Is there any specific deadline to apply?
No, applications are considered on a rolling basis.
What happens after the 12 months duration of my grant?
After your grant period is over or once you have 10,000 credits left, your plan will automatically convert to a Free plan, unless you have selected otherwise. If your project goes to the moon, you can also reach out to a team member at sales@elevenlabs.io anytime to help figure out a long term plan for your successful new product. However, not all projects go as planned so if after twelve months, your product doesn't take off, you'll have full flexibility to continue on a Free plan or upgrade to one of our Paid plans.
What happens if I need more text characters?
If you use all your 33M text characters prior to the conclusion of the 12month grant term, your plan will automatically convert to a Free plan, unless you have selected otherwise. You will receive an automatic email notifying you when you are close to hitting the 33M cap. At any time you can also reach out to a team member at sales@elevenlabs.io to help figure out a long term plan for your successful new product.
Can I resell or exchange my grants for cash?
You cannot exchange or resell your text characters. Reselling your text characters would be a violation of the ElevenLabs Grant program conditions and your grant plan will be terminated immediately.
Do you sign NDAs before an application is submitted?
Sorry, we are not able to sign NDAs for Grant applications.

Frequently asked questions
What is Studio designed for?
Studio is our end-to-end workflow for producing audiobooks, podcasts, and narrated videos. Structure long-form projects, assign speakers, align audio and video on a timeline, add music and SFX, and publish with captions
Does Studio support multilingual audio and captions?
Yes. Studio supports 32 languages and recognizes mixed-language text. You can generate video transcripts and multilingual subtitles and export captions
Can I assign particular speakers to specific text fragments?
Yes. Assign different voices to selected text fragments or sections to give each character or presenter a unique voice
Which file types can I upload?
Studio supports EPUB, PDF, TXT, HTML, MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV, and FLAC. You can also initialize your project from a URL
How does Studio integrate with other tools from your ecosystem?
Studio integrates with Voice Library, Voice Design, Professional Voice Cloning, Multilingual models, and Eleven Music for a complete production workflow
How do I edit video online with Studio?
Import MP4 or MOV and use the timeline editor to trim, merge, and edit video. Align audio and video, place music and SFX, and export ready-to-publish files
Can I add voiceover to video?
Yes. Record or generate a voiceover, then add voiceover to video and sync it on the timeline. You can also edit the narration by editing text
How do I add music to video or audio?
Use Eleven Music to generate a soundtrack or import tracks. Add background music to video, mix levels, and loop ambient SFX for seamless beds
Can Studio transcribe audio to text or video to text?
Yes. Upload audio or video to generate accurate transcripts. Edit speech by editing text and export transcripts or captions
How do I remove background noise from audio or video?
Use voice isolator to reduce background noise and remove reverb. It cleans dialogue for podcasts, voiceovers, and on-set recordings
Can I merge videos or fix out-of-sync media?
Yes. Use the video merger to join clips and the timeline to sync audio and video precisely
Does Studio include an online audio editor?
Yes. Edit MP3, WAV, and more. Trim, adjust, regenerate lines, and apply voice changer or isolator for clean, consistent output

Frequently asked questions
Can I clone my own voice with ElevenLabs Text to Speech?
Yes, ElevenLabs offers two ways to create a custom voice:
Instant Voice Cloning
lets you create a digital version of any voice from a short audio sample (around 1 minute). It's fast, available on paid plans, and ideal for getting started quickly.
Professional Voice Cloning
uses 30+ minutes of high-quality recorded audio to build a highly realistic clone that captures the accent, emotional range, and vocal traits of the original speaker.
Both options are designed with safety in mind. You must have permission to clone any voice, and we use AI Speech Classifier technology to detect cloned audio. Once created, your voice can be used across Text to Speech, Studio, Dubbing, and the API in 32+ languages.
How many voices are available, and can I create my own?
ElevenLabs gives you access to over 11,000 voices, including:
• Hundreds of premade voices spanning different ages, accents, tones, and styles.
• Thousands of community-shared voices in the Voice Library, searchable by language, gender, accent, and use case.
• Iconic voices from television and film for read-aloud and narration.
If you can't find the perfect match, you can also:
• Use
Voice Design
to generate a brand-new AI voice from a text prompt describing how it should sound.
• Use
Voice Cloning
to create a digital version of your own voice (with permission).
This is one of the largest voice libraries available in an AI text to speech platform.
What are the free plan limits? How many characters do I get per month?
The ElevenLabs free plan includes 10,000 characters per month, which is enough to generate roughly 10 minutes of audio. You also get access to:
• The full Text to Speech generator with premade voices.
• Voice Cloning (Instant Voice Cloning on paid plans).
• The Text to Speech API for developers.
• Generation in 32+ languages.
Paid plans start at a low monthly cost and unlock more characters, faster generation, Professional Voice Cloning, commercial use rights, and higher concurrency for production workloads.
Can I use the generated audio commercially?
Yes. Paid ElevenLabs plans include full commercial usage rights for the audio you generate, meaning you can use it in YouTube videos, podcasts, advertisements, audiobooks, films, games, and apps without paying additional royalties.
The free plan is intended for personal, non-commercial use and requires attribution to ElevenLabs. If you need to monetise your content or use audio in client work, upgrading to a paid plan unlocks full commercial usage rights.*
*
Commercial rights are subject to our Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy.
What's the difference between Multilingual v3, Flash, and Turbo?
ElevenLabs offers several Text to Speech models, each tuned for a different use case:
•
Eleven v3
- Our most expressive and emotionally rich model, with support for inline audio tags like [whispers], [laughs], and [excited]. Best for long-form content, audiobooks, film, and dramatic voiceovers.
•
Multilingual v2
- The most stable and lifelike model for high-quality content production across 29 languages. Best for narration and post-production.
•
Flash v2.5
- Ultra-low-latency model (sub-500ms end-to-end) supporting 32 languages. Best for real-time conversational AI, agents, and live applications.
•
Turbo v2.5
- A balance of quality and speed, suited for high-throughput use cases that still need natural delivery.
Most users start with Multilingual v2 for content and switch to Flash for anything real-time.
Does ElevenLabs Text to Speech support real-time streaming for AI agents and apps?
Yes. ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 delivers sub-500ms end-to-end latency, making it one of the fastest production-ready text to speech models available. The Text to Speech API supports audio streaming, so you can start playing speech to your users while the rest of the response is still being generated.
This makes ElevenLabs ideal for:
• Conversational AI and voice agents that need natural-feeling response times.
• Live customer support, telephony, and IVR systems.
• Real-time gaming NPCs and interactive experiences.
• Voice-enabled apps where every millisecond matters.
For full conversational use cases, ElevenAgents combines Text to Speech, Speech to Text, and an LLM into a single low-latency voice agent platform.
What audio formats can I export from ElevenLabs?
ElevenLabs Text to Speech supports a wide range of output formats so you can plug audio into any workflow:
•
MP3
- Standard format for podcasts, YouTube, and general listening.
•
WAV / PCM
- Uncompressed audio for studio work, dubbing, and post-production.
•
µ-law
- Optimised for telephony and call-centre integrations.
You can also choose your sample rate and bitrate via the API to balance quality and bandwidth for your specific use case.
How does ElevenLabs handle data privacy and security?
ElevenLabs takes data security seriously and is trusted by leading enterprise customers. Our compliance posture includes:
• SOC 2 Type II certified.
• ISO 27001 certified.
• PCI DSS Level 1 certified.
• GDPR compliant.
• HIPAA-eligible workflows for healthcare.
Your text input is not used to train our models without your consent. Enterprise customers can enable Zero Retention Mode for eligible services.*
Voice clones are protected by AI Speech Classifier technology that can detect AI-generated audio.
For ZRM-eligible services, where ZRM is correctly enabled, certain types of data are not retained. See documentation for details.
Can I control pauses, emphasis, and pronunciation?
Yes. ElevenLabs gives you several ways to fine-tune how your text is spoken:
•
Audio tags (Eleven v3)
- Use inline tags like [whispers], [laughs], [excited], or [sighs] to direct delivery and emotion.
•
Voice settings
- Adjust stability, similarity, and style to control how expressive or consistent the voice sounds.
•
Pronunciation dictionaries
- Define exactly how brand names, technical terms, or unusual words should be spoken.
•
SSML support
- Use Speech Synthesis Markup Language tags for precise control over pauses, emphasis, and phonemes via the API.
These controls let you go from raw text to studio-quality narration without re-recording.
Can I use ElevenLabs to practice pronunciation or learn a new language?
Yes, many learners use ElevenLabs as an AI pronunciation coach. Because our voices sound like real native speakers across 32+ languages and dozens of regional accents, you can:
• Hear how any word, phrase, or full passage sounds in another language.
• Compare British, American, Australian, Indian, and other English accents.
• Practice listening comprehension with longer passages of natural speech.
• Generate audio for vocabulary lists, dialogues, and reading exercises.
The free plan gives you 10,000 characters per month, enough for daily practice sessions, and ElevenReader lets you import articles and books to listen to on the go.
How does the ElevenLabs Text to Speech differ from other TTS technologies?
ElevenLabs voice AI combines proprietary methods for context awareness and high compression to deliver ultra-realistic, high-quality speech across a range of emotions.
Our contextual text to speech model is built to understand the relationships between words and adjusts delivery accordingly. It also has no hardcoded features, meaning it can dynamically predict thousands of voice characteristics.
What sets ElevenLabs apart from other TTS providers:
• Over 11,000 voices in the Voice Library, plus Voice Design and Voice Cloning.
• Low-latency generation (~75ms model inference*) with Flash v2.5, ideal for real-time agents and apps.
• Support for 32+ languages with native-quality accents.
• Eleven v3 model with audio tags for emotion, laughter, whispering, and more.
• Trusted by 100,000+ developers and leading enterprise customers.
Refers to model inference time only. Actual end-to-end latency will vary with factors such as your location and endpoint type used.
Does ElevenLabs offer multilingual text to speech, and how many languages does it support?
Yes. ElevenLabs supports text to speech in 32+ languages across our model lineup, with high-quality native accents in each.
Multilingual v2 supports 29 languages for the highest-quality long-form content. Flash v2.5 supports 32 languages with low-latency generation for real-time applications. Eleven v3 (alpha) also supports a broad set of languages with the most expressive, emotional delivery.
Languages include English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Hindi, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Russian, Dutch, Turkish, Swedish, Indonesian, Filipino, Ukrainian, Greek, Czech, Finnish, Romanian, Danish, Bulgarian, Malay, Slovak, Croatian, Tamil, Norwegian, Hungarian, and Vietnamese.
How much does ElevenLabs Text to Speech cost? Is there a free plan?
ElevenLabs Text to Speech is free to start. The free plan includes 10,000 characters per month (around 10 minutes of audio), access to premade voices, and the API.
Paid plans start at a low monthly price and unlock:
• More characters per month (up to millions on higher tiers).
• Commercial usage rights for monetised content.
• Professional Voice Cloning for hyper-realistic custom voices.
• Higher concurrency and faster generation for production use.
• Priority access to new models like Eleven v3.
Enterprise plans add SSO, custom contracts, dedicated support, and Zero Retention Mode for eligible services.

Frequently asked questions
Which Text to Speech model should I use?
- Flash v2.5 - Ultra-low latency (~75ms) for real-time applications like voice agents
- Turbo v2.5 - Balanced quality and speed (~250-300ms) for interactive use cases
- Multilingual v2 - Consistent quality for long-form content up to 10,000 characters
- Eleven v3 - Maximum expressiveness and emotional range for creative applications
What latency can I expect?
Flash v2.5 delivers ~75ms latency.
Turbo v2.5 typically responds in 250-300ms.
Both support streaming output, allowing playback to begin before generation completes.
How many languages are supported?
Eleven v3 supports 70+ languages.
Flash v2.5 and Turbo v2.5 support 32 languages.
Multilingual v2 supports 29 languages.

What are the character limits per request?
Flash v2.5 and Turbo v2.5: 40,000 characters
Multilingual v2: 10,000 characters
Eleven v3: 3,000 characters
Can I control emotion and delivery?
Use audio tags ([laughs], [whispers], [sighs], [door slam]) to control delivery, emotion, emphasis, pauses, and sound effects. Eleven v3 provides the most expressive control.
How many voices are available?
The voice library includes 10,000+ voices. You can also clone voices or design custom voices using text prompts.
Does the API support streaming?
Yes. Streaming allows you to start playback before the full audio is generated, reducing perceived latency in real-time applications.
Can I use custom voices?
Yes. Reference any voice in your library by voice ID, including professional voice clones, instant voice clones, and voices you've designed.
What audio formats are supported?
The API outputs MP3 by default. Additional formats include PCM and μ-law.
How do I optimize for latency?
Use Flash v2.5 with streaming enabled. Keep requests under 1,000 characters. Enable WebSocket connections for persistent real-time applications.
Is pronunciation customizable?
Yes. Use phonetic spelling or pronunciation dictionaries to control how specific words are spoken.
What SDKs are available?
Official SDKs for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript are available. You can also use the HTTP API.
Where can I find code examples?
Complete API reference, code examples, and integration guides are available at elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference
Do you offer enterprise support?
Yes. Enterprise plans include SOC 2 compliance, HIPAA support, GDPR compliance, EU data residency, zero retention mode, dedicated support, and custom SLAs.

Prohibited Use Policy
Last Updated 3 September 2025
This Prohibited Use Policy (“
Policy
”) supplements the
ElevenLabs Terms of Service
(“
Terms of Service
”) and applies to your access and use of our Services, including any Inputs you provide and Outputs you create. It also applies to your use within and outside our Website and our Services, whether directly or indirectly, as well as any attempts to engage in such use. Capitalized but undefined terms used herein have the meanings set forth in the Terms of Service.
Prohibited Uses
1. Do not threaten child safety.
For example, this includes accessing or using our Services to:
a) Create, distribute or promote sexually explicit material involving minors, or otherwise facilitate or promote the exploitation or sexualization of children, including minor grooming, nudity, or use of any material designed to impersonate a minor. We report material containing apparent child sexual abuse material to the relevant authorities and organizations where required by law or as we may otherwise deem appropriate in our reasonable discretion.
b) Create, distribute, or share age-inappropriate material, including material that targets minors and promotes sexual material, graphic violence, obscenity, or other mature themes.
c) Facilitate or promote child abuse or exploitation in any form.
d) Facilitate or otherwise contribute to cyberbullying or harassment of any minor, including without limitation by creating, distributing, or sharing material that shames, humiliates, bullies, or celebrates the suffering of any minor, or material that threatens a minor with bullying or harassment.
2. Do not engage in illegal behavior.
For example, this includes accessing or using our Services to:
a) Infringe, misappropriate, or otherwise violate another party's intellectual property rights.
b) Violate another party's privacy rights, as defined under applicable law.
c) Create or facilitate the exchange of illegal goods, services, or substances, including, without limitation, material that promotes or facilitates transactions in illegal drugs, firearms or explosive weapons, weapon development, other dangerous materials, counterfeit or deceptive goods or services, human trafficking, or sexual services.
3. Do not use the Services to facilitate activities that may significantly affect the wellbeing of others.
For example, this includes accessing or using our Services (including without limitation using ElevenAgents to power AI agents) to:
a) Engage in or facilitate the use, acquisition, or exchange of regulated drugs or other controlled goods and services, including advertising, medical advice, or providing instructions on their production, without our prior written authorization in each instance. This includes without limitation the marketing or provision of alcohol, tobacco products, controlled substances, prescription medications, recreational drugs, supplements, herbal remedies, and medical devices.
b) Provide tailored professional advice without (i) a qualified professional in that field reviewing the Output before it is made available to a consumer or the general public, and (ii) clear disclosure regarding the use and limitations of AI. This includes without limitation:
Financial advice or services, including lending services and cryptocurrency trading;
Legal services, including the issuance of legal interpretations or guidance; and
Health or medical advice, including diagnosis, treatment, and mental health services.
c) Facilitate real-money gambling activities or pay day lending.
d) Engage in or facilitate high-stakes automated decisionmaking which may affect an individual’s wellbeing.
To request approval per (a) above, please contact us
here
. Customers/users shall ensure all such uses comply with applicable law.
4. Do not engage in fraudulent, predatory, or abusive practices.
For example, this includes accessing or using our Services to:
a) Manipulate or deceive others in any manner likely to cause harm, including efforts to gain unauthorized access to non-public information, including credit card details and bank accounts, social security numbers, health data, or other sensitive information.
b) Defraud others, including via financial or other scams.
c) Evade product guardrails, including voice verification mechanisms such as Voice CAPTCHA.
d) Engage in or facilitate unauthorized robocalling, meaning the use of automated dialing systems or artificial/pre-recorded voice messages to place phone calls to individuals or businesses without direct human intervention.
e) Promote or facilitate the generation or distribution of spam (including by facilitating "call bombing" or other forms of communication that may overwhelm or disrupt systems or users). Harvest or bulk collect email addresses, phone numbers, or other contact information for the purpose of sending unsolicited communications.
5. Do not engage in unauthorized, deceptive or harmful impersonation.
For example, this includes creating or using ElevenLabs audio output to intentionally replicate the voice of another person:
a) without consent or legal right, including to take unauthorized action on behalf of such individual;
b) in a way that harasses or causes harm to that person, including via unauthorized sexualization;
c) in a manner intended to deceive others about whether the voice was generated by artificial intelligence.
6. Do not engage in voter suppression, candidate impersonation, or political campaigning in the context of elections:
For example, this includes accessing or using our Services to:
a) Incite, engage in, or facilitate voter suppression or other disruption of electoral or civic processes, including by creating, distributing, or facilitating the spread of misleading information.
b) Impersonate political candidates or elected government officials, regardless of whether authorization was obtained.
c) Engage in political campaigning, including promoting or advocating for a particular candidate, issue, or position, or soliciting votes or financial contributions.
7. Do not engage in unauthorized network access or surveillance or otherwise threaten the security, availability, or integrity of any network or system.
For example, this includes accessing or using our Services to:
a) Attempt to obtain unauthorized access to computer systems and networks, or to facilitate the disruption of critical infrastructure.
b) Facilitate the creation or use of malware or other harmful code, including without limitation spyware, communications surveillance, or other unauthorized means of monitoring of individuals.
8. Do not create violent, hateful, or harassing material outside of fictional contexts.
For example, this includes accessing or using our Services to:
a) Create, distribute, or engage in violent threats, extremism, or terrorism, including material that threatens, incites, or promotes violence against an individual or group.
b) Engage in, promote, or facilitate human trafficking, sexual violence, or other exploitation.
c) Discriminate based on protected characteristics, including race, national or ethnic origin, religion, age, sex, gender, sexual orientation, or physical ability.
d) Promote or facilitate harassment, including material that promotes harassing, threatening, intimidating, predatory, or stalking conduct or that otherwise promotes or celebrates the suffering of individuals or groups of individuals.
e) Promote or facilitate self-harm, including suicide or eating disorders.
f) Create, promote, or facilitate the spread of misinformation, including denying the existence of specific health conditions and other medical misinformation.
g) Promote or facilitate the use of harassing debt collection practices.
This section does not apply to activity in purely fictional contexts (e.g. violent speech by a character in a book, video game or movie) or when it is part of reporting on newsworthy activity by third parties (e.g. a news anchor reporting on terrorist activities).
9. Do not use our Services in any manner contrary to ElevenLabs’ policies, purpose or mission.
This includes:
a) If you are a free user, using our Services for any commercial purpose, including for advertising or running pyramid schemes, contests, or sweepstakes.
b) Selling, reselling, renting, leasing, loaning, assigning, licensing, or sub-licensing our Services without our prior written authorization. For the avoidance of doubt, this does not preclude your use of Output in accordance with the applicable terms and conditions.
c) Selling, reselling, renting, leasing, loaning, assigning, distributing, performing, licensing, sublicensing or commercially using or exploiting any Output (or any portion thereof) generated using our Sound Effects product on a standalone basis for any purpose, including as isolated files, audio samples, music or sound, libraries, or other collections of sounds.

e) Modifying our Services, removing any proprietary rights notices or markings associated with Output or our Services, or otherwise making any derivative works based upon our Services.
f) Using or attempting to use another user’s account or information without authorization from that user (or their organization for corporate accounts) and ElevenLabs.
g) Using our Services in any manner that could interfere with, disrupt, negatively affect, or inhibit other users from fully enjoying our Services or that could intentionally or negligently damage, disable, overburden, or impair the functioning of our Services in any manner.
h) Decompiling, disassembling or otherwise reverse engineering any aspect of our Services, or doing anything that might discover or reveal source code or model weights, or bypass or circumvent (i) measures employed to prevent or limit access to or use of any part of our Services or (ii) restrictions aimed at deterring or preventing uses of our Services that violate this Policy. l) Using any part of our Services or their Output as part of a dataset that may be used for training, fine-tuning, developing, testing, or improving any machine learning or artificial intelligence technology.
m) Making any use of our Services or their Output in ways that would be classified as “prohibited” or “high-risk” or by a similar description under applicable law, including Applicable AI Laws. “

Frequently asked questions
How quickly can I deploy an AI voice agent?
Most businesses can get a production-ready agent live in days, not months. With SDKs, APIs, and no-code tools, you can connect data sources, configure workflows, and launch agents across phone lines, apps, or websites with minimal engineering overhead.
Can agents handle both sales and support workflows?
Yes. Voice agents can resolve routine support queries instantly while also qualifying inbound leads or running outbound campaigns. Many teams deploy different agents for each workflow and orchestrate them together for end-to-end coverage
How human-like do the agents sound?
Agents speak with natural intonation, emotional range, and real-time responsiveness. You can choose expressive stock voices, clone your own, or even assign different personalities for different roles. Customers experience it as speaking to a knowledgeable, empathetic human rather than a bot.
What languages do voice agents support?
Voice agents can converse in 70+ languages and switch dynamically within a single conversation. This allows businesses to serve global audiences without separate workflows for each market.
How do AI agents integrate with my existing systems?
Agents connect to CRMs, support desks, telephony providers, and internal APIs. They can fetch account details, update records, trigger workflows, or book appointments in real time, all while keeping the conversation natural.
Can I ensure compliance and data security with AI voice agents?
Yes. Enterprises can deploy agents with SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, and EU data residency support. Features like zero-retention mode, encrypted storage, and role-based access controls ensure compliance with strict regulatory frameworks.
What kind of ROI can I expect from voice agents?
Voice agents typically reduce cost per interaction by over 60%, cut onboarding time for new staff in half, and significantly boost customer satisfaction. Some customers report resolving up to 90% of issues on the first call and unlocking millions in incremental revenue.
Do agents always replace humans?
Not at all. Agents are designed to handle high-volume, repetitive tasks and free human staff for complex or sensitive cases. They also support seamless handoff: when a call transfers to a human, the full conversation history and context carry over.
What happens if my business needs change over time?
AI voice agents are modular and fully customizable. You can adjust workflows, voices, and integrations as your business evolves. Some companies start with inbound support automation and later expand to outbound engagement, training, or sales.
Which LLMs can I use with ElevenAgents?
You can use ElevenAgents-hosted LLMs for low-latency production calls or connect external and custom LLMs via supported integration paths.
How do human handoffs work?
Define escalation rules - agents include full conversation history and context when handing a call to a human, synced to your CRM or ticketing stack.

What are common uses for AI voice changers?
AI voice changers are used across many industries: in gaming for creating character voices, in content creation for unique narrative voices on YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram, in podcasts for adding variety, in marketing for professional voiceovers, in e-learning for engaging educational content, and in entertainment for dubbing and animation.
What makes ElevenLabs the best AI voice changer?
ElevenLabs offers unmatched quality, naturalness, and customization options. Our technology preserves emotional delivery including whispers, laughs, and subtle cues, something most voice changers cannot achieve. With thousands of voices, 29 language support, fast processing times (~400ms), and powerful API integration, ElevenLabs serves both casual creators and enterprise users.
How many languages does the voice changer support?
The voice changer supports 29 languages including English (USA, UK, Australia, Canada), Japanese, Chinese, German, Hindi, French, Korean, Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, Indonesian, Dutch, Turkish, Filipino, Polish, Swedish, Bulgarian, Romanian, Arabic, Czech, Greek, Finnish, Croatian, Malay, Slovak, Danish, Tamil, Ukrainian, and Russian.
Can I use my own custom or cloned voice?
Absolutely. You can use any voice from our library or create custom voices through our voice cloning feature. Simply provide your custom voice's ID when using the voice changer, and your recordings will be transformed into that specific voice.
How many languages and accents does the voice changer support?
The voice changer supports 29 languages, including many regional accents and dialects. We regularly update our collection with new languages and accents. For a particular accent, record audio in that accent and use it with the voice changer.
Can I change my voice to a different gender?
Yes. Our AI voice changer can transform voices across genders while maintaining natural delivery. Change a male voice to female, female to male, or to any voice in our library regardless of the original speaker's gender.
What audio file formats are supported?
Our voice changer accepts common audio formats including MP3, WAV, and AAC. You can also record audio directly through our web interface using your microphone.
How much does the voice changer cost?
Our voice changer is accessible with a generous free plan that lets you experience the technology at no cost. Paid plans start at competitive price points and offer additional features, more processing time, and API access. Enterprise pricing is available for organizations with high-volume needs.
Is there API access for developers?
Yes. Our Speech to Speech API provides programmatic access to voice transformation capabilities. Developers can integrate voice changing into applications, games, and services with comprehensive documentation and SDKs. The API supports batch processing, custom voices, and advanced parameter controls.

Frequently asked questions
What is AI voice cloning and how does it work?
AI voice cloning uses artificial intelligence to create a digital replica of any voice. You upload audio samples, and our deep learning algorithms analyze the unique vocal characteristics including tone, pitch, accent, and speaking style. The result is a voice model that can generate new speech in that voice using text to speech technology. The process captures subtle details like inflection and emotional expression to produce natural-sounding, lifelike results.
Are there any quality free AI voice cloning tools available?
Yes, many platforms offer free AI voice cloning options with limited usage. Free plans typically allow you to create voice clones and generate a limited amount of audio each month. This lets you test the voice quality and features before committing to a paid subscription. Premium plans unlock additional features like higher quality output, more languages, API access, and commercial usage rights.
How do I use an AI voice cloning tool?
Using an AI voice cloning tool is straightforward. First, record or upload a clear audio sample of the voice you want to clone. For instant cloning, 1-5 minutes of audio works well. The AI then processes your audio files and creates a voice model. Once complete, you can type any text and generate speech using your cloned voice. Most tools also let you adjust settings like speaking speed, pitch, and emotional tone.
What is the difference between instant and professional voice cloning?
Instant voice cloning creates a voice replica quickly using short audio samples of 1-5 minutes. It's ideal for rapid content creation and testing. Professional voice cloning requires more audio, typically 30+ minutes, and produces significantly higher quality results that are nearly indistinguishable from the original voice. Professional cloning is recommended for audiobooks, commercial voiceovers, and any project requiring broadcast-quality audio.
How secure is AI voice cloning technology?
Reputable AI voice cloning platforms implement multiple security measures to protect your voice data. This includes end-to-end encryption for all audio uploads, secure storage of voice models, and voice verification systems that confirm you have permission to clone a voice. Your voice data is never shared or used for training without explicit consent. Enterprise plans offer additional security features like SSO, audit logs, and dedicated infrastructure.
Is AI voice cloning legal for creating audio content?
Yes, AI voice cloning is legal when used appropriately. You can freely clone your own voice for any purpose. Cloning someone else's voice requires their explicit consent. Using cloned voices for fraud, impersonation, or creating misleading content is illegal in most jurisdictions. Commercial use may require appropriate licensing depending on the platform and intended application. Always review the terms of service for your specific use case.
Can AI voice cloning be used to mimic any voice?
Technically, AI can clone virtually any voice given sufficient audio samples. However, ethical and legal considerations apply. You should only clone voices you have explicit permission to use. Many platforms require voice verification to prove you're authorized to clone a particular voice. Some voices may also be protected by copyright or personality rights, particularly those of celebrities or public figures.
How much audio do I need for high-quality voice cloning?
For instant voice cloning, 1-5 minutes of clear audio produces good results. For professional-grade voice cloning, we recommend 30 minutes minimum, with 3 hours being optimal for the best possible quality. The audio should be clean, without background noise, and feature only one speaker. High-quality voice recordings with proper microphone technique produce better results than phone recordings or audio with environmental noise.
Which languages does AI voice cloning support?
Modern AI voice cloning supports 32+ languages including English, Japanese, Chinese, German, Hindi, French, Korean, Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, Indonesian, Dutch, Turkish, Polish, Arabic, Russian, and many more. Once you create a voice clone, it can speak any of these supported languages while maintaining your unique vocal characteristics. This makes it ideal for creating multilingual content without recording in each language.
Can AI voice cloning be used for creating realistic voiceovers?
Absolutely. AI voice cloning is widely used for professional voiceover production. Content creators use it for YouTube videos, podcasts, audiobooks, e-learning courses, advertisements, and corporate training materials. The technology produces natural-sounding results that work well for most voiceover applications. For the highest quality, professional voice cloning with extensive training audio delivers broadcast-ready results.

Will my data be shared with anyone else?
No. We want this to be a true partnership and give you 2 options:
We use your data to help our train models to perform better for your domain. This benefits everyone, but nobody has access to your data.
We use your data for something specific to you, e.g. fine tuning.
Is my dataset too small to be interesting?
We don’t have minimum requirements. Even small amounts of data can help us better serve low-resource languages and accents.
I’m not sure about the licenses I have for my data – should I still apply?
Yes! We can help you figure this out.

General Data Protection Regulation
Data Administrator
In accordance with Article 13 of the Regulation \EU\ 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC \General Data Protection Regulation) (“GDPR”), we inform you that the administrator of the personal data is ElevenLabs Poland LLC with its registered office on ul. Lipska 27/22, 03-907, in Warsaw, KRS No. 0000989620; tax identification No. (NIP): 1133069847; Polish statistical No. (REGON): 522982080; , hereinafter referred to as the “Administrator”.
Contact Details
The Administrator has a Data Protection Officer. If you have any questions or concerns about how your details are handled, you can contact us via the following email address:
pawel@elevenlabs.io
Purpose and Legal Basis for Processing
Your personal data will be processed for the purpose of organizing and enabling your communication with the Administrator, participation in the ElevenLabs events, as well as for the promotion of the Administrator and its future projects within internal and marketing communications, including presentations, informational brochures, and other marketing materials, as well as for the promotion of the ElevenLabs on the Administrator’s social media - based on Article 6\1)(a) of the GDPR.
Categories of Data Processing
The Administrator processes personal data in the following scope:
Image, recorded by video and/or photograph.
First and Last Name.
E-mail address
Company
Duration of Data Processing
Consent to use the image for the above purposes is given without territorial limitations for a period of 2 years. After this time, the image will no longer be used unless the Participant withdraws their consent before this period ends. Personal data in the form of the first and last name will be processed for the time necessary to organize the Event, and then potentially only for such time as required by applicable law (e.g., limitation periods) or as necessary to defend or pursue claims.
Requirement to Provide Personal Data
Providing personal data in the form of the first and last name is voluntary, but failure to provide it prevents participation in the Event. In the case of the image – it is voluntary and does not affect the possibility of participating in the Event.
Data Recipients and Information on Processing Personal Data in Third Countries
The recipients of the data are the Administrator’s personnel in connection with the purposes described above, as well as social media recipients where your image will be published. Data recipients may also include entities providing services to the Administrator, such as IT, graphic, photographic, marketing, and social media services, as well as public authorities or entities authorized to receive data under applicable law. In certain circumstances (especially in the case of publishing your image on social media), we may transfer your personal data to another country, including countries outside the EEA. When transferring data to third countries, for which there is no European Commission decision stating an adequate level of data protection, we will rely on: an applicable derogation or exemption for a specific situation (e.g., your explicit or separate consent); or implement appropriate safeguards (e.g., standard contractual clauses issued by the European Commission or binding corporate rules approved by the relevant supervisory authority, as appropriate), to ensure the protection of your Personal Data. Copies of the applied safeguards can be obtained by contacting the email address provided above.
Automated Decision-Making, Including Profiling
Data is not subject to automated decision-making, including profiling.
Rights of the Data Subject and Additional Information
You have the right to access your personal data, the right to request its rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and the right to object to the processing. In particular, you have the right to object to certain publications, and in the case of such an objection, the Administrator will remove such a publication from the social media profile or website it administers.
The Administrator is only responsible for publications of the image made in electronic media administered by itself. To the extent that your personal data is processed based on consent \Article 6\1)(a) GDPR\, you also have the right to withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal. In connection with data processing, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Office for Personal Data Protection, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsa

June 9
Behind the Agent: How Urban Company Automated Partner Support at Scale
Voice AI is rewriting the rules of customer operations at scale.

Urban Company is proof of what happens when a team builds for it.

In this session, Vinay Srinivas (ElevenLabs) sits down with Abhishek Thakur (Voice AI Lead, Urban Company) for a behind-the-scenes look at one of India's most ambitious voice AI deployments.

We're skipping the theory and going straight to the build: how a recently IPO'd company replaced hundreds of manual agents with voice AI that gig workers can't distinguish from a human, across hundreds of thousands of calls every month.

What you'll learn
- Why voice is the only channel that works for India's gig workforce, and how Urban Company proved it at production scale
- The voice quality bar that makes or breaks trust: what failed, what worked, and the technical hacks that closed the gap
- Three live use cases powering UC's partner operations today
- Scaling across 7 languages in India, and why multilingual is a prerequisite, not a feature
- Real metrics: call volume pre vs. post agent, partner NPS, cost per interaction, and what changed
June 11
Behind the Agent: Wie KÖMPF24 den Kundenservice mit KI skaliert
Kundenerwartungen entwickeln sich schneller, als die meisten Unternehmen mithalten können. Personalisierung ist längst kein Differenzierungsmerkmal mehr – sie ist eine Grundvoraussetzung.

In dieser Session gehen wir gemeinsam mit KÖMPF24 - einem der führenden Online-Händler Deutschlands - hinter die Kulissen und zeigen, wie KI-Agenten den Kundenservice im E-Commerce neu gestalten. Von automatisierter Ticketbearbeitung bis hin zu skalierbaren Kommunikationslösungen: Wir zeigen, wie man Agenten von Grund auf baut und was erfolgreiche Deployments auszeichnet.

Was euch erwartet:
- Der aktuelle Stand von E-Commerce und warum die Skalierung des Kundenservice zur Priorität wird
- Live Deployment Walkthrough mit KÖMPF24: Wie ein Unternehmen mit 20+ Onlineshops KI-Agenten für Ticketmanagement und automatisierte Kundenkommunikation einsetzt
- Live Workshop: Wie ein Agent mit ElevenAgents konfiguriert, und skaliert wird
- Q&A: Eure Fragen, live beantwortet

Load More
Past recordings
May 28
Live-genomgång: Bygga en AI-agent för detaljhandeln
Kundernas förväntningar förändras snabbare än de flesta organisationer kan anpassa sig. Personalisering är inte längre en konkurrensfördel – det är ett grundläggande krav. Och standardautomatisering håller inte längre måttet.

I den här live-workshopen går vi igenom hur AI-agenter omformar detaljhandeln och marknadsplatser – från proaktiv shoppingassistans till kundsupport dygnet runt – och vad som skiljer piloter som stannar av från implementeringar som går ut i produktion och skalar.

Du kommer att se verkliga produktionsexempel från företag som Meesho, Deliveroo och CARS24, gå igenom en live-demo av ett komplett detaljhandelsagentflöde och lämna med en tydlig bild av hur en implementering ser ut från början till slut.

Vad vi går igenom:
- Skiftet mot agentisk handel och varför personalisering 2026 är en självklarhet
- Live-genomgång om att bygga en AI-driven concierge-shopping- och skalbar kundsupportagent
- En live-demo av ett komplett detaljhandelsagentflöde, från produktupptäckt till support efter köp
- Resultat och lärdomar från Meesho, Deliveroo, Immobiliare.it och CARS24
May 27
Live Workshop: Deploying Agents Across Every Channel
Your customers don't all communicate the same way - your agent shouldn’t either.

Some want to call. Some want to message. Some want to email. Your agent needs to meet them where they are - without you rebuilding it from scratch for every channel.

Voice is the hardest channel to get right. Most teams bolt it on last. In this workshop, we flip that and show you how getting voice right first makes every other channel easier to deploy and maintain.

Configure once, deploy everywhere.

Amanda Milberg (Enterprise Forward Deployed Engineer) will walk through a live build: one agent acting as your brand representative across telephony, email, and messenger - with one knowledge base, one set of workflows, and one place to monitor and improve.

What we'll cover

- Why voice is the hardest channel to configure - and why building it first (not bolting it on later) changes everything

- How to configure a single agent for voice and chat without duplicating logic

- Connecting WhatsApp alongside your existing voice or web deployment - including mid-conversation media like image uploads

- Cross-channel context - keeping agent behavior consistent when customers move between channels

- What breaks in production, and how to configure against it before go-live

May 7
Live Workshop: Build Safe AI Agents for an Enterprise Deployment
Getting an AI agent to handle conversations is the easy part. Getting your security team, legal team, and customers to trust it is where most enterprise deployments stall.

Agents without proper guardrails may drift off-course mid-conversation, take unexpected actions, get manipulated by adversarial users, or expose sensitive data.

In this session, we'll walk through a layered approach to agent safety, how to test and deploy in stages so you can catch issues before they scale, and what it takes to get security and legal on board.

What we'll cover:
- Why agents fail in production and the patterns behind it
- The safety controls that keep agents compliant, on-brand, and manipulation-resistant
- How to stress-test agents with simulated conversations before they go live
- A staged deployment approach that lets you resolve issues in real time
- The frameworks and certifications that help get security and legal buy-in

April 29
Leading with AI: How Klarna Rebuilt Marketing with AI
AI has changed what's possible in marketing.

Klarna is proof of what happens when a team actually runs with it.

In this session, Luke Harries (Head of Growth, ElevenLabs) sits down with David Sandström (CMO, Klarna) for one of the most tactical conversations in AI marketing.

We're skipping the theory and going straight to the workflows — the exact processes, tools, and team structures behind one of the most significant AI transformations in marketing today.

What you'll learn
1. How Klarna rebuilt core marketing workflows with AI from the ground up

2. The tools, processes, and team structures that made it possible

3. How they drove organization-wide AI adoption — and what most companies get wrong

4. Why creativity is becoming the last true differentiator in the AI era

5. Tactical takeaways you can bring back to your own team
April 28
Warsztaty na żywo: Budowanie skalowalnych agentów głosowych AI w praktyce
Większość firm dostrzega potencjał głosowych agentów AI. Problem pojawia się, gdy przychodzi do wyboru właściwego sposobu ich wdrożenia.

Podczas tego 45-minutowego warsztatu na żywo przedstawimy praktyczne podejście do wdrażania głosowych agentów AI w skali. Będzie to szansa, aby zobaczyć live demo, poznać najnowsze funkcje ElevenAgents i wyjść z konkretnym planem wdrożenia.

ElevenLabs zasila głosowych agentów AI dla takich przedsiębiorstw jak Deliveroo, Revolut i Cisco.

Co omówimy:
- Jak wiodące przedsiębiorstwa wdrażają dziś głosowych agentów AI w środowiskach produkcyjnych
- Jak budować multimodalnych agentów AI w różnych kanałach
- Jak wygląda gotowy do produkcji tech stack od początku do końca
- Jak ocenić kontrolę, szybkość wejścia na rynek i skalowalność dla organizacji
- Live demo + wgląd w najnowsze funkcje ElevenAgents
April 27
Workshop en Vivo: Construye tu Agente de Atención al Cliente en 45 Minutos
April 22
Live Workshop: The AI Agent Playbook for Financial Services
Customers in financial services expect instant, accurate, human-feeling support - whether they're checking a balance, disputing a charge, or navigating a loan.

Meeting that bar at scale, across languages, across channels, while staying compliant, is one of the hardest operational problems in the industry.

AI agents are solving for it.

Revolut cut resolution times by 8x. Klarna is handling front-line US phone support at 10x the speed. Better.com doubled lead-to-lock conversion.

In this session, we'll show you how they did it, give you a live look at ElevenAgents in action, and share what's coming next.

What we'll cover
- Where AI agents in BFSI are headed - and the use cases delivering real ROI today
- Learnings from enterprise deployments like Klarna, Revolut, and Better and live demos
- How to get compliance and legal over the line - PCI DSS, GDPR, data residency, and the world's first insurable voice AI platform via AIUC-1
April 16
Live Workshop: Building a Voice Agent for Startups
A hands-on workshop where we'll build an ElevenLabs agent from scratch, showcase the latest agent features, and leave time for your questions.

Whether you're a current ElevenLabs Startup Grant holder or a founder exploring what's possible with voice AI, this session is built for you.

What we'll cover:

0→1 live build - learn how to build a fully functional ElevenLabs voice agent from scratch
What to think through before you build- architecture decisions, use case scoping, and where most teams go wrong early
A walkthrough of the newest updates to the ElevenLabs Agents platform
How to get started with the Startup Grant - what the program covers and how to apply or make the most of your grant
Live Q&A
March 31
Rethinking Marketing Creative in the World of AI
In the past six months, AI creative tools for image, video, and production have gotten quite good. And fast. That's started forcing real conversations inside enterprise marketing teams like: where should in-house creative be focusing? Where is the best place to put budget in creative right now? Where do we still need the help of agencies? What does the future of a marketing team look like when marketers have access to more tools for self serve creative with AI?

We're bringing on marketing leaders who are using AI for creative production to share what's actually changed inside their orgs. They'll show us the tools they're using, the workflows they've built, the team and budget decisions they've made, and plans for investing in creative in the future.

This conversation will be a mix of strategy (where does AI fit) and tactics (how are you using AI right now).

We'll cover subjects like:
- How marketing leaders are reallocating creative budgets now that AI is in the mix
- Real AI-generated creative from B2B marketing teams: what they made, how they made it, what it replaced
- Where AI is genuinely good enough and where humans still win
- What the creative function actually looks like inside a modern marketing org
- Any examples of where AI hasn’t worked for creative and common mistakes

If you're starting to wonder where AI fits into your creative strategy and how to spend your next dollar, this one's for you.
March 31
Behind the Agent: How Learna Scales Voice Learning with ElevenLabs
Language learning only works if it sounds real. For Learna, getting voice right was critical.

Learna puts users in FaceTime-like conversations with an AI tutor, and the quality of that voice directly determines whether users stick around and pay.

After running a live A/B test against their legacy TTS system, the results were clear: 9% uplift in trial conversion and 11% uplift in lifetime value.

In this session, their team walks through how they think about voice as a growth lever - across multiple languages, multiple apps, and multiple use cases.

You'll walk away with:
- How voice quality directly impacts conversion and LTV - and how to test for it
- What it takes to scale natural, low-latency voice across Spanish, Turkish, Arabic and beyond
- How Codeway built a shared voice infrastructure across a multi-app portfolio
